Kallari backflips into the sky. After a short duration, she may target an Enemy to dash towards them, dealing 35/55/75/95/115 (+45% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals 2x damage if the Target is affected by Death Mark.
source_abilities.Passive:
Dealing damage to an Enemy Target applies Death Mark, revealing them for 3.5s. After the duration, the Mark detonates, dealing 15 (+5 per level)(+7 (+2% physical power)% of Target's missing health) true damage.
Death Mark cannot be re-applied to a previous Target for 10s.
Additionally, Kallari can periodically jump up to 2 additional times.
source_abilities.Q:
After 1.5s, enter Camouflage, gaining 40% decaying movement speed for 6s. While in this state, nearby Enemy Heroes and Wards reveal Kallari.
Attacking ends Camouflage instantly.
Passive: Gain 2 (+75% physical penetration) Health Regeneration when Out of Vision.
source_abilities.R:
After a brief delay Kallari dashes forward, cutting through all Enemies in her path, dealing 120/250/380 (+65/75/85% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals up to 2.5x damage based on the Target's missing health.

khaimera.counterplay: Hold disengage for Ambush, then separate him from the target before sustain stacks take over. Invigorate cleanses and grants brief crowd-control immunity, so land key control after he spends it; time anti-heal to contact and avoid fighting beyond allied peel.
khaimera.pick_when: Use jungle pressure to force sustained contact while a lane ally supplies escape denial; offlane is a lower-priority lane option that builds Rage from minions.

source_abilities.E:
Khaimera instantly Cleanses all Debuffs and Heals himself for 5/7/9/11/13% of his maximum health (+4x current health regeneration).
Cleansing grants Crowd Control Immunity for 0.25s.
source_abilities.Q:
Unleash Khaimera's primal spirit for 3s, granting him maximum attack speed for 5 successful attacks.
Khaimera gains an additional attack for every 30 Magical Power owned. 
Each basic attack deals (+54/58/62/66/70% physical power)(+12% magical power) physical damage, applies on-hit effects at 65% effectiveness and Cleaves nearby Enemies for 75% damage.
source_abilities.R:
After a brief channel, Khaimera slices all Enemies in front of him, Stunning them for 1.25s and dealing 200/400/600 (+200% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage over 6 hits. The final hit Slows by 25% for 1.25s.
Grants 20 Rage stacks for each Enemy Hero or Monster hit.
source_abilities.RMB:
Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70% physical power) physical damage and Slowing them by 25/30/35/40/45% for 1.35s. Deals up to 2x damage based on the Target's missing health. 
Grants 15 Rage on hit.

kira.counterplay: Keep an interrupt for Purge and pressure after Shadow Glide is used. Break the extended attack exchange rather than allowing her to build stacks on an undefended frontline target.
kira.pick_when: Pick a follow-up carry when allies can buy a sustained firing or Purge window.

source_abilities.E:
Dash 475/525/575/625/675 units in your current movement direction, becoming briefly Unselectable and gaining an additional 5/10/15/20/25 Bonus Physical Power for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.
Cooldown Resets on Takedown.
source_abilities.Passive:
Nevermore activates every 15/14.5/14/13.5/13/12.5/12/11.5/11/10.5/10/9.5/9/8.5/8/7.5/7/6.5s (-0.5 per Level), empowering Kira.
While empowered, Kira's next Basic Attack or Mercy blast fires a Raven at the target that explodes on impact, dealing (+7% of the Target's Current Health) physical damage to all targets in a small area.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460% physical power) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s.
These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike.
While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.

kwang.counterplay: Move away from the placed sword before committing; respect the tether boundary without treating it as a stun. Do not stack around the sword and grant both the damage and control sequence.
kwang.pick_when: Pick sword-centered containment when allies can follow the same location.

source_abilities.E:
Kwang dashes forward, becoming Unselectable and dealing 75/100/125/150/175 (+45% magical power) to all Enemy Units he passes through. 
When the Blade is in the world, if Kwang dashes within 300 units of its radius he will summon it back to his hand with a crash of lightning, dealing the damage to all nearby Enemy Units and Knocking them Up for 0.25s.
source_abilities.Q:
Throw the Heavenly Blade at a target location to deal 90/115/140/165/190 (+40% magical power) magical damage.
Enemies hit by the Blade will be Tethered to it for 1.3s. 
When in the world, the Blade grants vision in a small area around it.
Recalling the Blade early will break the Tether.
source_abilities.R:
Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade, dealing 230/340/450 (+80% magical power) magical damage and applying a 45/55/65% Slow for 2s to nearby Enemy Units. 
If the Blade is in the world, Kwang will Teleport to it before striking.
source_abilities.RMB:
Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage to nearby Enemy Units. 
While holding the Blade, it deals 75/110/145/180/215 (+60% magical power)(+70% physical power) magical damage and grants Kwang a 65/95/125/155/185 (+40% magical power) (+9% health) Shield for 2.5s. 
If the Blade is in the world, it deals 90/125/160/195/230 (+80% magical power)(+80% physical power) true damage instead.

legion.counterplay: Leave Orbital Sanction's path and re-engage after the standard or defensive displacement is spent. Do not hold ground in his napalm: the Scorched Earth plan leaves burning zones where mines and Frag Order explode and under the beam.
legion.pick_when: Pick physical area damage into an allied catch, with another slot protecting the backline.

source_abilities.E:
Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% physical power) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies. 
The Standard rallies nearby Allies for 8s if they remain within 1500 units. 
Allies gain 8% Movement Speed and heal for 5/8/11/14/17 (+100% physical penetration) (+10% magical power) Health every Second.
Additionally, Enemy Wards are Revealed.
Legion gains Infinite Ammo.
source_abilities.Q:
Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world, Enemies or by reactivation. 
Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Slows Enemies hit by 40% for 1s. 
Consecutive Mine hits on the same Enemy deal 25% Damage.
source_abilities.R:
Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, an Orbital Beam blasts the designated location, tracking Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes.
Enemy Targets within the blast take 30/50/70 (+26% physical power) (+10% magical power) Physical Damage every 0.25s. The Orbital Beam persists for 6/7.5/9s.
If there are no Enemy Targets within 2000 units, the blast remains stationary.
source_abilities.RMB:
Legion cooks a Grenade with a 2.2s fuse, reducing the time before detonation based on duration held. 
Throw the Grenade causing an explosion that deals 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Launches Legion or Enemies hit. The Grenade automatically explodes after 0.2s if it is near an Enemy.
When cooked for the full duration, it will explode in Legion's hand.
If Legion is Stunned, Killed or cancels the ability whilst cooking the Grenade, it drops to the floor.

lt-belica.counterplay: Respect the Seismic Assault line and manage the exposed low-mana window. Remove or leave the drone's pressure area; do not confuse an empty mana bar with safety from her finisher.
lt-belica.pick_when: Pick compact, repeatable catch conversion when the team needs direct control from mid.

source_abilities.E:
Deploy a drone for 12s that grants vision in the area and drains 2/2.75/3.5/4.25/5% of nearby Enemy Heroes' Current Mana each second. 
The drone zaps nearby Heroes if they cast an ability, or if Lt. Belica damages them with an ability, dealing 60/70/80/90/100 (+20% magical power) magical damage and draining 2.5% of the Target's Maximum Mana. 
Innovation: Zap Max Mana drain increases to 6%.
source_abilities.Q:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/145/190/235/280 (+60% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s. 
Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.
The hitbox width is 270u. This ability can be Blink-proxied during the cast.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a heavy blast from Lt. Belica's sidearm, dealing 200/325/450 (+65% magical power) magical damage and silencing them for 0.5s. Damage increases by 25/30/35% of the Target's Missing Mana. 
For Manaless Heroes, the damage increases by 20/25/30% of the Target's Missing Health. 
Innovation: Resets Cooldown upon killing an Enemy Hero with the blast.
source_abilities.RMB:
Place a bomb that detonates after a short delay, dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+70% magical power) magical damage. Restores 6/7/8/9/10 Mana for each Enemy hit. 
Innovation: Detonate a second time after a short delay, dealing 80 (+30% magical power) magical damage.

maco.counterplay: Separate the carry from the support zone, contest the movement landing and avoid stacking for Maco Strike. Anti-heal helps only if someone can keep it applied to the healing recipient.
maco.pick_when: Choose an ally-focused support when the team can stay in range of his chosen space.

source_abilities.E:
Maco leaps high into the air before slamming back down to the ground with his gemstone, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70% magical power) magical damage to Enemies and Slowing them by 30% (+5% magical power) for 1.5s.
If Maco hits an Enemy Hero, he gains a 60/115/170/225/280 (+50% magical power) (+4% health) Shield for 3.5s.
After landing, Maco dashes slightly in the direction he is currently moving.
source_abilities.Q:
Maco lobs a gemstone that explodes in a small area, dealing damage or healing, based on the Target hit.
If Maco hits himself or an Ally, they are Healed for 40/60/80/100/120 (+35% magical power) Health in addition to 1/1.5/2/2.5/3% of their Max Health. Allies also gain 8/9/10/11/12% (+3% magical power) Movement Speed for 2.5s.
If Maco hits an Enemy, they take 75/105/135/165/195 (+45% magical power) magical damage.
source_abilities.R:
Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels.
When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 70/110/150 (+35% magical power) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it.
At the gemstone's max range, it explodes, dealing 100/160/220 (+50% magical power) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 0.25-1.4s, based on charge time.

morigesh.counterplay: Deny Mark range and force her to cross exposed space. Once marked and low, leave before the finishing window rather than assuming walking outside ordinary spell range removes the threat.
morigesh.pick_when: Pick short-range marked-target pressure when allies can supply the safe approach.

source_abilities.E:
Become the swarm, gaining 50% decaying Movement Speed and 12% (+1.5% magical power) Damage Reduction for 3.5s. Passing through Enemy Units deals 110/150/190/230/270 (+75% magical power) magical damage and restores health equal to 30% of the pre-mitigated damage dealt. Healing is reduced by 75% against Minions. 
Swarm's effect is fully refreshed if it damages an Enemy Hero, and its duration is extended by 0.5s when colliding with Non-Heroes. Morigesh also gains an additional 25% Decaying Movement Speed over 1s when colliding with Non-Heroes.
source_abilities.Q: Throw a hive of insects that explodes dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+65% magical power) magical damage and Slowing targets hit by 50%, decaying over 3s.
source_abilities.R:
After a brief channel, Summon a horde of insects to stab the Marked target, dealing 320/450/580 (+80% magical power) magical damage.
The Mark is removed upon casting this ability.
source_abilities.RMB:
Select an Enemy Target to deal 60/80/100/120/140 (+45% magical power) magical damage and, if they are a Hero, Mark them.
Damaging Enemy Targets with Mark absorbs part of their soul restoring 8/18/28/38/48 (+20% magical power) Health, increasing by 15% against Heroes for each stack of Pestilence they possess.
Killing an Enemy Unit with Mark refunds 50% of its cooldown, and 65% of the Mana spent.

mourn.counterplay: Use units and angles against the first-target Abduct line. Spread from close sustain pressure and regroup safely during Eclipse instead of chasing through the loss of vision.
mourn.pick_when: Pick catch plus sustain when you want both a way in and a defensive response afterward.

source_abilities.E:
Mourn channels energy into his fist for up to 2.1s, expanding up to 800u over 1.5s. While channeling, Mourn gains 20% Damage Reduction and Slows himself by 30%.
At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Enemies within take 80/110/140/170/200 (+45% magical power) magical damage and are Mesmerized for 0.45-1.2s (based on 0-1.5s channel duration).
source_abilities.Q:
Mourn vomits magical bugs that attach to nearby Heroes and Monsters. 
Mourn and Allied Heroes hit restore 3/6/9/12/15 (+7% magical power) health every 0.5s for 3s, gaining 5 (+8% Physical Armor) Physical Armor and 5 (+8% Magical Armor) Magical Armor for the same duration.
Enemies take 8/12/16/20/24 (+8% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s for 3s and have their Base Physical Armor and Base Magical Armor reduced by 5 and their Bonus Physical Armor and Bonus Magical Armor reduced by 12%.
source_abilities.R:
Mourn channels to absorb all light from the map for 4s, causing all Enemy Heroes to have massively reduced vision.
Additionally, Mourn applies Contagion to all Heroes in the world and gains 40/60/80% Movement Speed for the duration.
source_abilities.RMB:
Channel for up to 3s, Slowing yourself by 25% and wind up your vines, increasing their range over 1s. After 3s the ability will be cancelled and go on a 50% cooldown.
Confirm to unleash the vines that will collide with the first enemy target hit dealing 80/125/170/215/260 (+85% magical power) magical damage, Pulling them towards Mourn and Slowing them by 90% for 0.75s.

murdock.counterplay: Approach around armed traps, preserve movement after Buckshot and respect the distant shot when low. Force the escape before the main diver enters.
murdock.pick_when: Choose self-peel and distant catch conversion for a practiced carry; 1.17 raised Buckshot and Long Arm of the Law damage but does not make him a default pick.

source_abilities.E:
Murdock activates his sirens, granting him 25% decaying movement speed for 4s. During this time, Murdock gains 15/20/25/30/35% attack speed, stacking on re-activation up to 5 times.
Cooldown Resets on Takedown.
source_abilities.Q:
Place a trap that arms after a short delay, dealing 40/80/120/160/200 (+100% physical power)(+120% magical power) magical damage to any Enemy Hero that steps on it and Rooting them for 1.25s. 
Traps last for 40/45/50/55/60s and up to 3/3/4/4/5 may be placed at one time.
Max Charges: 2.
source_abilities.R:
Murdock kneels, preparing an energized sniper shot with unlimited range that can travel through anything.
While targeting, using the Alternate Ability input will zoom the scope inwards.
Upon firing, it deals 280/430/580 (+120% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in its path, ignoring any physical armor.
source_abilities.RMB:
Discharge a Terrain piercing shotgun blast, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 (+100/120/140/160/180% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies hit, decreasing by up to 50% based on distance and Shredding their physical armor by 15% for 4s.
The blast Pushes Enemies Back, its force increasing at close range.

muriel.counterplay: Force protection on one target before switching focus, and punish her forward positioning: 1.17 lowered her durability. Track Reversal's landing and Serenity's charged stun; anti-shield does not replace interrupting or escaping the allied damage hero she enables.
muriel.pick_when: Pair her amplification and protection with a reliable damage threat and initiation elsewhere.

source_abilities.E:
Throw an orb that applies a 80/120/160/200/240 (+50% magical power) shield to the first Allied Hero it touches, granting them 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Decaying Movement Speed for 4s.
Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.
source_abilities.Q:
Sanctify the ground with an angelic light for 6s. 
Allies within the area gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Total Attack Speed and restore 60/80/100/120/140 (+20% magical power) Health over its lifetime.
Enemies within the area have their Total Attack Speed reduced by 10/11.5/13/14.5/16% and receive 90/120/150/180/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage over its lifetime.
source_abilities.R:
Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 30% Damage Reduction and a 280/480/680 (+100% magical power) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location.
On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100/160/220 (+40% magical power) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.
source_abilities.RMB:
Charge a piercing bolt of energy for up to 4s that deals 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slows by 35% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. 
If Muriel charges Serenity for 1.1s it reaches max charge and deals 98/147/196/245/294 (+70% magical power) magical damage and Stuns the target for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s instead.
If Muriel cancels the charge, 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the cost is refunded.
Projectile radius: 85. Projectile speed: 3900 (official patch-note values).

narbash.counterplay: Spread or disengage from the prolonged group fight, apply anti-heal and keep a response for the ultimate channel. Bait Thunk before diving rather than treating his heal as his only threat.
narbash.pick_when: Pick grouped sustain and a direct Thunk catch for an organized front-to-back fight.

source_abilities.E:
Toggle: Play a soothing beat, granting Narbash and his Allies additional Speed or Healing.
Healing Aura: Grants 1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5/5.5 (+2% magical power) Health Regeneration.
Speed Aura: Grants 4.5/5.5/6.5/7.5/8.5% (+3% [HasteIconWhite]) Movement Speed.
source_abilities.Q:
Bellow out a rallying war cry, granting Narbash and empowered version of Song of My People for himself and his nearby Allies for 3/3.25/3.5/3.75/4s.
Speed: Gain 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% (+4.5% magical power) Movement Speed.
Healing: Gain 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% magical power) Health Regeneration.
source_abilities.R:
Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5/7.5/10 (+3% magical power)(+5% physical power) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. 
Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead.
The final hit deals 80/150/220 (+80% magical power)(+120% physical power) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.
source_abilities.RMB: Toss a drumstick that deals 95/140/185/230/275 (+85% magical power)(+130% physical power) magical damage in a tiny area of effect, Knocking Back and Stunning the Enemies hit for 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s.

neon.counterplay: Avoid the returning construct as well as the outgoing hit. Track the empowered cast and punish a spent dash; magical armor does not negate the explicitly true-damage part of the return.
neon.pick_when: Choose a practiced spell sequence and keep a reposition for the return trade.

source_abilities.E:
Neon lobs a projectile. After 0.5s of landing or colliding with an enemy target, it detonates, dealing 85/120/155/190/225 (+60% magical power) Magical Damage and slowing targets by 35% for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4s.
Overclocked: Targets are Mesmerized as well as Slowed.
source_abilities.Passive:
Casting a Basic Ability grants one Thread. At 3 Threads, Neon's next basic ability becomes
Overclocked, consuming the stacks to unleash a powerful additional effect.
source_abilities.Q:
Neon sends out a Data Construct, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5% magical power) Magical Damage to enemies it passes through. The Data Construct then returns to Neon, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5% magical power) True Damage on its way back.
Overclocked: Before returning, the Data Construct emits a pulse at its maximum range, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5% magical power) True Damage.
source_abilities.R:
Neon Overclocks her systems for 8s, gaining 15/20/25% Movement Speed, 45% Jump Height, and causing all her Basic Abilities to be Overclocked for the duration.
Recast: During System Overdrive, Neon can recast this ability to jump upwards and launch an explosive bomb, dealing 155/225/295 (+55/60/65% magical power) magical damage, increased by up to 90% based on the target's missing health.
source_abilities.RMB:
Dash in the current movement direction, Empowering your next Jolt within 3s to explode, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+40% magical power) bonus Magical Damage to the target and nearby enemies as well as Slowing them by 20% for 0.5s.
Overclocked: Can be Recast once within 3s at no cost.

phase.counterplay: Pressure the link positioning, separate the pair and wait out Hyperflux when possible. Bait the rescue pull before committing the second catch. Her lower 1.17 health and post-cast healing make early trades against her more rewarding; she does not supply a frontline.
phase.pick_when: Choose one dependable repeated-attack partner when the team already has initiation.

source_abilities.Passive:
After casting an ability, restores 10/13/16/19/22/25/28/31/34/37/40/43/46/49/52/55/58/61 (+40% magical power) health over 3s. Linked allies receive the same healing. This effect can stack.
Additionally, Phase's Blink costs 40 mana but has a reduced Cooldown of 60s. Upon use, it increases her damage dealt by 15% for 3s.
source_abilities.R: Phase overcharges herself and her Linked Ally, granting both 35/55/75% attack speed, 40/60/80 ability haste and 35% decaying movement speed for 8s.
source_abilities.RMB:
Create a Link between yourself and an Ally, granting both Heroes 3/4/5/6/7% increased Physical Power and Magical Power. If reactivated, Phase will Pull the Linked Ally towards her.
The Link will turn Pink if any Ally wanders too far out of range and will break if they do not return within 1s.
Allies that are Immobilized cannot be Pulled.
Maximum link radius is 1700u. If the linked ally is 2100u away, the link breaks immediately, regardless of the one-second grace window.

rampage.counterplay: Watch the carried boulder, which Behemoth throws instantly, and spread so a Pounce landing cannot shatter it across several allies. Apply anti-heal while damage can follow; don't chase his jungle regeneration route blindly.
rampage.pick_when: Pick a durable jungle catch that can land Boulder Throw from range, keeping Pounce for follow-up, peel or an exit.

source_abilities.Passive:
Rampage gains (+0.1/0.12/0.13/0.15/0.16/0.18/0.19/0.21/0.22/0.24/0.25/0.27/0.28/0.3/0.31/0.33/0.34/0.36% health) bonus health regeneration. This regeneration is doubled while in the Jungle. 
Upon being immobilised, Rampage gains 25 Tenacity for 4s and restores (+3% health) of his maximum health over the same duration.
source_abilities.Q:
Rip a boulder from the earth and carry it for up to 5s. Rampage can throw the boulder, dealing 100/135/170/205/240 (+60% physical power)(+80% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Stunning them for 1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4s. Shatters on contact with Enemy Heroes.
Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.
source_abilities.R:
Become enraged, growing in size and altering Rampage's abilities for 10s. During this time he gains 200/450/700 maximum health and 3%(+10% magical power) Movement Speed.
While Behemoth is active, Rampage restores 1.5/2.75/4% of his maximum health per second. This is increased by 4% for each Enemy Hero within a 1000 unit radius of Rampage.
source_abilities.RMB:
Leap forward before slamming down to the ground, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+5% health) physical damage to nearby Enemies and launching damaged Heroes backwards. The leap can be cancelled early by basic attacking.
Using Pounce while Boulder Throw is active causes it to shatter upon landing, dealing its effects in the area.
Behemoth: Range increases by 65%.

renna.counterplay: Contest the setup and keep a response for the ultimate rather than standing inside its full duration. Pressure an exposed collection route and punish a spent defensive tool.
renna.pick_when: Choose farming and sustained magical follow-up into a protected, prepared fight.

source_abilities.E:
Renna shifts upwards and prepares to launch a ball of demonic energy.
Upon re-activating or after 1.5s, Renna will launch the orb that explodes on contact dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+50% magical power) damage and mesmerizing Targets hit for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
Deals an additional 1% of the Target's Current Health as Magical Damage per 30 Essence.
source_abilities.Passive:
Entities that die near Renna have a chance of leaving behind their Essence that can be consumed by moving nearby. Heroes always leave behind Essence. Essence enhances Renna's abilities directly.
If Renna Jumps while mid-air, she will begin to hover, falling slowly.
source_abilities.R:
After a 1.5s channel, Renna teleports to the Target location and summons an infernal singularity above herself for 5s that unleashes projectiles every 0.5s at nearby Targets that deal 60/78/96 (+24% magical power) magical damage.
Lasts 0.5s longer per 50 Essence.
source_abilities.RMB:
Swing your weapon to fire 3 piercing projectile waves over 1.5s that each deal 50/57/64/71/78 (+21% magical power) damage.
Swings faster to create an additional projectile within the same duration per 50 Essence.

revenant.counterplay: Use his shot/reload rhythm to choose trades and avoid being the isolated low-health target. Keep allied area damage focused elsewhere if Reckoning removes the original focus.
revenant.pick_when: Pick short-window burst and a coordinated isolation target, rather than a generic attack-speed carry plan.

source_abilities.E:
Launch a cursed orb that deals 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and apply 4 stacks of Marked for 6s.
Dealing damage to a Marked Target deals 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and consumes a stack.
Upon consuming all stacks, the Target is Rooted for 1s.
source_abilities.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 53/55.38/57.89/60.52/63.29/66.18/69.19/72.34/75.61/79.01/82.54/86.19/89.98/93.89/97.92/102.09/106.38/110.8 (+85% physical power) physical damage.
The final round will always critically strike.
After four basic attacks, Revenant will automatically reload.
source_abilities.Q:
Unleash 10 ethereal missiles within a wide cone that home towards random Enemies. If a Target is Marked by Scar, the missiles prioritize them instead. 
Each missile deals 35/50/65/80/95 (+40/55/70/85/100% physical power) (+60/65/70/75/80% magical power) physical damage. 
Enemy Heroes and Monsters take 10% damage from missiles beyond the first.
source_abilities.R:
Revenant pulls himself and his Target into the Nether Realm for 6/7/8s and Slows them by 80% for 0.7s. During this time, he steals 8/9/10% of their Physical & Magical Power.
Killing his opponent inside the Nether Realm grants 2x the bonus gold gained from Bounty Hunter.

riktor.counterplay: Keep units or terrain between you and the hook line, then punish a miss without entering silence range. Do not offer a second clumped target to Skewer while rescuing the first.
riktor.pick_when: Choose a practiced hook player with immediate allied conversion and another peel option after the catch.

source_abilities.Q: Swing an electrified whip that destroys enemy shields before dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+70% physical power)(+60% magical power) magical damage and Silencing them for 0.8s.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a torrent of chains from Riktor, dealing 110/200/290 (+45% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Suppressing them for 1.3s. 
After the Supression expires Riktor rips the chains out, repeating the damage.
source_abilities.RMB: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.

scarlett.counterplay: Force mobility and energy expenditure before the extended fight. Spread from the ultimate's conversion area and punish the exit instead of racing an uninterrupted ability sequence.
scarlett.pick_when: Pick a practiced offlane skirmisher with reachable follow-up, and treat Ashen Vow's disputed base damage conservatively.

source_abilities.E:
Scarlett dashes forward with a decisive, fiery strike that deals 65/85/105/125/145 (+80% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in her path and receives a 30/80/130/180/230 (+40/45/50/55/60% physical power) Shield for 3s.
Each time Scarlett hits an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader with First Intent she refreshes her Shield's duration and increases its size by 60%, and restores 50 Energy.
source_abilities.Q:
Scarlett channels for a short duration, before swinging her Lantern around her, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 (+60% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area.
Outer Edge hits deal 25/50/75/100/125 (+100% physical power) additional damage and Slow targets hit by 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% for 1.25s. 
Outer Edge hits on Enemy Heroes or Camp Leaders Empower Scarlett's next Cindara attack for 4s, causing it to now damage all Enemies in a line in front of her, dealing 15 (+12% physical power) (+3/3.5/4/4.5/5% Target's Max Health) bonus damage, and restoring 35/45/55 Energy upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader.
Empowered Cindara damage is reduced by 50% against Minions and is capped against Monsters.
Ablaze: Empowered Cindara's bonus damage is increased by 1.5x.
source_abilities.R:
Scarlett strikes forward with her lantern, with its chain Restraining the first Enemy Hero hit for 1.4s, and Slowing nearby Enemies by 65% for 1s.
Scarlett then backflips into the air, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the Restrain, and ignites her Blade before striking down at her target, dealing 180/280/350 (+100% physical power) physical damage. 
Enemies near the Restrained Hero also receive 100% of the strike's damage.
After striking, Scarlett's Blade remains Ablaze for 8/10/12s, granting her +150 Basic Attack Range, 5 Energy Regen, 20/32/44 (+12% physical power) Physical Power, and enhancing certain abilities for the duration.
Range is 960u.
source_abilities.RMB:
Scarlett twirls in her current movement direction, with its speed increasing based on current momentum. 
Scarlett then stabs forward 3 times, with each dealing 21/31/41/51/61 (+24/28.5/33/37.5/42% physical power) physical damage. The final stab deals up to 125% bonus damage based on the Target's Missing Health.
Stabs benefit from Lifesteal and can Critically Strike at 60% effectiveness. 
Ablaze: Number of Stabs is increased to 4, dealing 15% more damage overall.

serath.counterplay: Save peel for her reappearance or landing and deny the first takedown. Protect low-health allies: the resulting visage can extend Heresy and shorten the next ability cycle.
serath.pick_when: Pick a second-wave diver after the first enemy control is committed, with a clear route to the next target.

source_abilities.E:
Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage.
Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s
source_abilities.Passive:
Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s.
Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
source_abilities.Q:
Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% physical power) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters.
On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position.
If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
source_abilities.R:
Serath takes demonic form, dealing 60/90/120 (+50% physical power)(+80% magical power) physical damage to nearby Enemies and setting them ablaze.
For the next 7s, she gains 20/25/30% movement speed, 20/40/60% attack speed, and empowers her basic attack with Infernal Strikes. 
Infernal Strikes sets Enemy Units ablaze on-hit, dealing 14/26/38 (+20% physical power)(+20% magical power) true damage on-hit over 2s.

sevarog.counterplay: Contest his early soul farming without blindly invading. If Subjugate chains you, stay inside until the chain ends rather than walking out into its stun, and avoid lining up for Colossal Blow into hostile space.
sevarog.pick_when: Pick scaling frontline when the team can protect the early stacking route.

source_abilities.E:
Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing 60/75/90/105/120 (+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Slowing them by 30% and Chaining them to the center for 2s.
If a Chained target leaves the zone, they take 75/90/105/120/135 (+60% magical power) magical damage and are Stunned for 1.25s.
source_abilities.Passive:
Sevarog gains Souls when he Kills an Enemy with an ability. Each Soul grants 2 bonus health. 
Sevarog reaches an additional Tier of power at 40/80/120/160 Souls, gaining 40/80/180/350 bonus health and new effects:
• Tier 1: +5% Omnivamp.
• Tier 2: Gain an Aura that Shreds nearby Enemy Heroes' Magical Armor by 15%.
• Tier 3: Siphon grants 2x Maximum Health from Stealing.
• Tier 4: Reflect 10% of damage taken to nearby enemies.
source_abilities.Q:
Strike forward with a spectral hand, dealing 80/95/110/125/140 (+4% health)(+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies. 
Deals 30/35/40/45/50 additional damage to Monsters.
If Siphon damages an Enemy Hero, Sevarog steals 1.8/2/2.2/2.4/2.6% of their Maximum Health for 15s.
source_abilities.R:
Deliver a heavy blow from Sevarog's hammer, dealing 200/330/460 (+75% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him.
Enemy Heroes struck by the blow are Knocked Back, sending them flying.
At maximum rank, Colossal Blow Executes Minions.

shinbi.counterplay: Back out before she reaches maximum Track stacks for All-Kill!, and punish only after both Rushing Beat charges are spent. Avoid treating her as a tank simply because she remains in melee range.
shinbi.pick_when: Pick repeated magical trades and a finishing stack sequence when another role can absorb the opening.

source_abilities.E:
After a short delay, summon 4 Spirit Wolves that circle Shinbi for 2.4s, granting 20% decaying movement speed and a 45/65/85/105/125 (+35% magical power) shield for the same duration and after the wolves expire.
The wolves deal 30/42/54/66/78 (+22% magical power) magical damage per hit, up to 3 times.
source_abilities.Q:
Summon a Spirit Wolf that runs in a straight line towards your reticule and passes through all Enemy Targets dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+55% magical power) magical damage.
After hitting a target, deals 60% damage to subsequent Minions.
source_abilities.R:
Passive: Shinbi applies a Mark to Enemy Heroes that she damages with her abilities, lasting for 6s. Additionally, each time Shinbi damages a Hero with an ability she gains a stack of Track for 6s, stacking up to 8 times. 
Upon reaching maximum Track stacks, Shinbi can activate this ability.
Active: Shinbi summons a pack of 8 Spirit Wolves above each currently Marked Enemy Hero. The pack attacks their target, dealing 44/68/92 (+16% magical power) magical damage per Spirit Wolf.
source_abilities.RMB:
Shinbi dashes forward through the air, dealing 50/85/120/155/190 (+55% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies she passes through. 
Max Charges: 2

skylar.counterplay: Force flight or Hypercharge before the actual dive and use cover while the damage window runs. Flight changes the angle; it does not establish immunity to control or ranged pressure.
skylar.pick_when: Choose a confident ranged carry player with peel and a safe firing angle.

source_abilities.E:
Skylar thrusts upwards in her current movement direction, gaining the ability to hover for 3.75s.
During this time, Skylar's basic attack range is increased by +100. Dealing damage while hovering also fires a missile that deals 10/15/20/25/30 (+20% physical power)(+12% magical power) physical damage to the same target. This can only occur intermittently with Hypercharge but the time decreases with bonus attack speed.
source_abilities.R: Channel for a short period of time before firing a large orb of unstable energy. The orb stops on the first hero hit, exploding, dealing 200/330/460 (+150% physical power)(+90% magical power)(+20/25/30% of target’s missing health) physical damage.
source_abilities.RMB:
Skylar hypercharges Starfire for 5s (refreshes on Hero Takedown):
Convert bonus attack speed into on-hit physical damage and attack at a fixed rate of 10 attacks per second while also ignoring 20% of your Target's Bonus Physical Armor. Starfire's damage is modified to 1/2.5/4/5.5/7 (+10% physical power)(+4% magical power)(+10% attack speed) per instance and it applies on-hit effects at 10% effectiveness. Damaging Enemy Units with Hypercharge increases its damage by 1% for 1s, stacking up to 25 times.
Passive: Basic Attacks deal 4/8/12/16/20 (+10% physical power) bonus physical damage on-hit.

sparrow.counterplay: Dive from a second angle after peel is spent or disengage from Inner Fire before returning. Never donate a stationary frontline target while she has a protected firing line.
sparrow.pick_when: Pick sustained physical damage when allies can guarantee room to attack rather than just start a fight.

source_abilities.E:
Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15% magical power) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s.
Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15% physical power) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
source_abilities.Passive:
Sparrow's Basic Attacks and Abilities apply stacks of Relentless to Enemy Units. 
Her Basic Attacks against Targets afflicted by Relentless deal an additional 0.25% of their maximum health as bonus physical damage On-Hit, per stack.
Relentless stacks last for 3s, stacking up to 8 times.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

steel.counterplay: Spread against Shield Slam, bait Force Shield and change the attack angle. Punish Bull Rush used to enter after his control ends; don't place both damage heroes on the same landing point.
steel.pick_when: Pick direct catch and projectile protection, with enough allied damage to convert the control.

source_abilities.E:
Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles for 4s.
When an Enemy Hero first passes through the wall, they take 50/75/100/125/150 (+30% magical power) magical damage and are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.75s.
source_abilities.Q:
Steel charges forward, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the dash and dealing 85/125/165/205/245 (+5% health)(+70% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in his path. 
Enemy Heroes struck by Bull Rush are Knocked Back. Monsters and Minions are Stunned for 2s.
source_abilities.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.
source_abilities.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.

terra.counterplay: Respect the empowered control and ultimate window, then trade afterward. Keep distance from the charged or committed sequence rather than feeding her preferred sustained melee exchange.
terra.pick_when: Pick her as a practiced, matchup-specific frontline answer when her armor-scaled control fits the draft; she is not a default pick in either role.

source_abilities.E:
Throw a spectral axe, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+30% physical armor)(+30% magical armor) physical damage to all Enemies in its path.
Enemies hit by Highland Hurl are Slowed by 40% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. and have their Physical Armor reduced by 20% for 4.5s.
Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
source_abilities.Q:
Terra spins her axe, striking all Enemies around her before slashing forward a second time. Each strike deals 50/80/110/140/170 (+35% physical armor)(+35% magical armor) physical damage.
Enemy Hero hits refund 10% of the cooldown per strike.
Empowered: Terra strikes three times, with the third strike dealing an additional (+5/6.25/7.5/8.75/10 Target's Max Health)% damage to all Enemies in front of her.
source_abilities.R:
Terra’s helmet slams down, Cleansing all debuffs and disabling Enemy Towers within 1650u for 4/4.5/5s. When this occurs, she instantly gains maximum Hersir stacks and Slows all nearby Enemy Units by 60%, decaying over 2s.
For the next 8/9/10s, Terra gains 16/30/44 Physical Armor, 16/30/44 Magical Armor and 50/100/150 Tenacity.
Passive: Gain 6/9/12 Physical Armor and 6/9/12 Magical Armor.
source_abilities.RMB:
Terra becomes Unstoppable and Channels for up to 3.5s before dashing. She deals 27/48/69/90/111 (+40% bonus physical armor) (+40% bonus magical armor) physical damage to all Enemies in her path, stopping if she collides with a Hero. Enemies hit are Knocked Back for 0.25s.
For the first 1.25s, dash range and damage increases, dealing up to 81/144/207/270/333 (+120% bonus physical armor) (+120% bonus magical armor) physical damage. 
Empowered: On Enemy hit, gain a 5/65/125/185/245 (+10/12/14/16/18% health) shield for 3.5s.

the-fey.counterplay: Keep movement for Fly Trap's delay, spread before the pull and avoid donating repeated Nettles hits. Approach from a second angle instead of stacking inside the prepared damage area.
the-fey.pick_when: Pick prepared catch into magical area damage with a durable ally establishing the space.

source_abilities.E:
Throw an orb of energy, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+55% magical power) magical damage. Hitting the same Target within 8s deals 20% increased damage, stacking up to 4 times.
Harvest Nettles refunds 75% of its mana cost upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Killing a Unit.
source_abilities.Q:
Summon a patch of thorny brambles, dealing 90/130/170/210/250 (+70% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies that touch them and Slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Allies within the brambles gain 15% movement speed for 0.5s.
Bramble Patch persists for 5s before wilting.
source_abilities.R:
Plant a magical seedling, awakening a giant fly trap that attaches itself to all nearby Enemy Heroes. 
After a brief delay, it Pulls its victims inward, dealing 250/375/500 (+100% magical power) magical damage and Stunning them for 1s.

twinblast.counterplay: Force Rocket Dash, then send the second threat. Keep moving through Ventilate's aim and avoid giving repeated free attack-spell exchanges while your escape is unavailable.
twinblast.pick_when: Pick ability-attack weaving and self-repositioning for a practiced carry.

source_abilities.E:
Passive: When TwinBlast deals damage to an Enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Ability, Rocket Dash's cooldown is decreased by 8/9/10/11/12%. Reduced to 3.2/3.6/4/4.4/4.8% when damaging Non-Heroes.
Active: TwinBlast dashes in his current movement direction.
source_abilities.Passive: Casting an ability grants TwinBlast 20% increased Total Attack Speed and will cause his next basic attack within 4s to fire three times for a total of 142.5% damage, with each shot applying on-hit effects at 60% effectiveness.
source_abilities.Q: TwinBlast charges and fires two superheated piercing projectiles in the target direction, dealing a total of 100/140/180/220/260 (+90% physical power)(+120% magical power) physical damage and applying on-hit effects to all Enemy Units hit at 170% effectiveness.
source_abilities.R:
Transform your guns into fully automatic machine guns, unleashing a barrage of 30 (+10% Total Attack Speed) bullets over 3s dealing 15/20/25 (+9% physical power)(+9% magical power) physical damage per bullet. 
Can Critically Strike at 75% effectiveness.

wraith.counterplay: Use cover against the shot line and track the reveal and rewind setup. Check the augment before choosing armor: Mystic Marksman makes Knock, Knock! magical, while the midlane Sniper's Bounty build keeps it physical.
wraith.pick_when: Pick a practiced skill-shot carry with a clear damage-conversion plan and catch assistance.

source_abilities.Q:
Launch a piercing Nanite Grenade that deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+60% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage to all Units hit, Slowing them by 35% for 1.25s. Units hit are also Marked for 3.5s, Revealing them.
Knock, Knock! is enhanced against Marked Units, dealing an extra 5.5/6/6.5/7/7.5% (+1.5% magical power per 100 Magical Power) of their maximum health as bonus magical damage.
source_abilities.R: Wraith can choose an Enemy Hero he can see up to 1550/1650/1750 units, marking their location from 2s prior. After a 1.5s delay they will enter Limbo and Teleport back to this location.
source_abilities.RMB:
Fire a long-range sniper shot that deals 20/35/50/65/80 (+110% physical power)(+70% magical power) physical damage to the first Enemy Unit hit. Damage is increased by 100% against Enemy Minions. Knock, Knock! benefits from lifesteal.
If Knock, Knock! Kills, or Damages a marked Unit, 35% of the Mana Cost is refunded and its Cooldown is decreased by 75%.

wukong.counterplay: Keep the escape route covered and identify the real hero before committing scarce control. Do not infer clone on-hit behavior or spend all peel chasing an expendable copy.
wukong.pick_when: Pick mobile pressure and repeated access while another hero supplies the dependable frontline.

source_abilities.E:
Spirit:
Wukong spins his staff around himself gaining 25% (+50% physical penetration) Damage Reduction for the duration. Afterwards he throws the staff forward dealing 60/80/100/120/140/160 (+70% physical power) damage and Stunning for 0.8s.
Body:
Wukong enlarges his staff and slams down to the ground dealing 60/100/140/180/220/260 (+135% physical power) damage and slowing by 40% for 0.75. This damage is increased by drop distance up to 1500 units. Minions receive 70% less damage.
source_abilities.Passive: Double Jump to leap into the air.
source_abilities.Q:
Spirit:
Wukong gains 6/7/8/9/10/11% movement speed and creates a trail of cloud, walkable by allies for 4s.
Body:
Wukong leaps in the current movement direction gaining 20/24/28/32/36/40% (+60% physical penetration) Attack Speed for 4s.
source_abilities.R:
Switch between Body and Spirit Stances
Upon damaging Enemies 5 times, a hair leaps from Wukong and lands, spawning a Clone. Clones deal (+12% physical power) physical damage per hit and have 16%( health) Health. Wukong may have up to 2/3/4/5 clones at one time.
Leaving combat will reset the counter.

yin.counterplay: Bait Backlash or wait out the projectile-control window, then commit from another angle. Do not assume a projectile answer stops ground areas or non-projectile control; a Ground effect now interrupts Lash Kick.
yin.pick_when: Pick a confident projectile-timing player into attacks her defensive tools can actually answer.

source_abilities.E:
Passive: Every third successful consecutive basic attack will deal 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% of the target’s maximum health as bonus physical damage and heals Yin for +(10/12/14/16/18% physical power) Health.
Active: Yin extends her whip, increasing the range of her basic attack to 1100 units 
and gaining 30/40/50/60/70% cleave for 6s.
source_abilities.R:
Yin surrounds herself in gale winds.
For 5s, the winds will apply a 10% Slow to Enemies within and grants Yin 10% movement speed. 
Enemy projectiles that travel through it are halted.
source_abilities.RMB:
Yin cracks her whip, Pushing away nearby Enemies. Deals 20/40/60/80/100 (+100% physical power)(+60% magical power) physical damage and creates a sphere of pressure around her for 0.8s.
If Enemy projectiles hit the sphere, they are reflected toward the target location.

yurei.counterplay: Avoid leaving a chain of marked reachable targets. Punish Severance without its reset condition, and hold control, including a Ground effect, for the 1.5s Soulstorm channel rather than following her through every reset.
yurei.pick_when: Pick marked-target mobility and attack weaving after an ally creates the opening.

source_abilities.E:
Rush forwards, dealing 55/75/95/115/135 (+115% physical power) physical damage to targets hit.
Colliding with a target affected by Soul Rip consumes it to reset the cooldown of Severance and tear their Soul from the target for 4s. Souls linger around their hosts with 8% of their maximum health and share any damage dealt to them with their host.
Consuming Soul Rip with a Soul still active will refresh its health.
source_abilities.Q:
Perform a spinning kick that deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+70% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.
If cast in-air, you will additionaly leap upwards in your current movement direction.
Heal 20/35/50/65/80 (+75% physical power) health, increased by 0-50% based on missing health if an Enemy Hero or Monster is hit.
source_abilities.R:
Channel for 1.5s, dealing 75/125/175 (+50% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and applying Soul Rip to them.
At the end of the duration, pull all targets towards you, tear their spirits and strike downwards, dealing 130/215/300 (+80% physical power) physical damage and reset the cooldown of Severence.
source_abilities.RMB: Launch three projectiles that explode, each dealing 30/40/50/60/70 (+35% physical power) damage to targets hit and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.

zarus.counterplay: Do not spend burst into Barricade's damage reduction; step away from its stunning swing. Keep an escape or peel response for Coliseum and attack the unsupported entry. The arena limits movement but does not silence or stun everyone inside; continue using valid defensive tools.
zarus.pick_when: Pick jungle containment with mid/support conversion and a disciplined exit plan.

source_abilities.E:
Dash in your current movement direction, gaining 20% movement speed for 1s and 12/16/20/24/28% (+20% magical power) Attack Speed for 3.5s.
If cast in-air, you will additionally dash slightly upwards in your current movement direction.
source_abilities.Q:
Unfold a shield for 1.5s, reducing incoming damage by 75%.
Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing 54/70/86/102/118 (+90% physical power) physical damage increased up to 135/175/215/255/295 (+225% physical power) and Stunning targets hit for 0.75s.
source_abilities.R:
Leap at an Enemy Hero, dealing 200/325/450 (+100% physical power) physical damage. A Coliseum is then summoned for 4s, Zarus gains maximum stacks of Gladiator and its bonus is doubled. 
If the target is killed within the duration, you will permanently gain 5/8/11 Physical Power.

zinx.counterplay: Bait Neural Regenesis before the decisive focus, or change targets during protection; its cooldown is shorter at lower ranks on 1.17. Spread from the bouncing control and track the actual Infuse recipient instead of assuming every build heals allies equally.
zinx.pick_when: In support, choose protection for a planned committed fight with another slot initiating; in offlane, choose her ranged attack-and-spell pressure beside another frontline.

source_abilities.E:
Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals 45/65/85/105/125 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Slows by 35% for 0.75s.
After 0.75s, the radiation erupts dealing 55/85/115/145/175 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Slowing Enemies hit by 35% for 0.75s.
source_abilities.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 46/48.38/50.89/53.52/56.29/59.18/62.19/65.34/68.61/72.01/75.54/79.19/82.98/86.89/90.92/95.09/99.38/103.8 (+55% physical power) physical damage.
Enemies hit are afflicted with a stacking DoT that deals 12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2/21/22.8/24.6/26.4/28.2/30/31.8/33.6/35.4/37.2/39/40.8/42.6 (+12% magical power) (+0.6 per Level) magical damage on-hit over 3s.
source_abilities.Q:
Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing 65/90/115/140/165 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Stunning for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The disk can ricochet up to 5 times, dealing its damage again and Stunning each target for 50% of the original duration. 
Will not ricochet to previously hit targets.
source_abilities.R:
Apply cellular restructuring to Yourself or an Ally Hero, granting 45% decaying Movement Speed and Revival for 4s.
If the Target takes lethal damage within this time, they Resurrect with 500/900/1300 (+235% magical power) Health and 250/400/550 (+110% magical power) Mana after 2.5s.
source_abilities.RMB: Fire a healing bolt at an Ally that restores 60/95/130/165/200 (+50% magical power) Health, increasing by up to 50% based on their missing health.

strategic_review.method: Authored synthesis of 1.17 kits and official changes, the current reviewed plans, Pred.gg Gold+ 1.17 role and matchup results (small, about 1.5 days) and the retained 1.16.4 review. Counterplay is a tactical judgment, not a measured lane advantage. Each note is shown only while the ability text it relies on is unchanged. Source roles, sample scopes and disagreements remain separate.

guidance.summary: One-time Patch 1.17 strategy review for Gold+ play. Tier grades, hero counterplay, counter picks, build adaptations, compositions and working pools were re-checked against exact 1.17 ability text, the official 1.17 changes and the 2.32 build plans. Early 1.17 results cover about 1.5 days, so grades moved only where a kit reason and the evidence agreed. The playbook still favors a coherent win condition over assembling five high win rates.

abilities.game_description: Irradiate Drongo's basic attacks, granting him 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 4s. During this window, shots Irradiate Enemies for 1.5s, the timer refreshing with each hit. After Irradiate expires, the target erupts, dealing 8/15/22/29/36 (+22%) physical damage to them for the first stack, and 8/15/22/29/36 (+22%) for subsequent stacks. Applies an additional stack of Wastelander per Irradiate stack. If Drongo damages irradiated targets with Old Rusty or Shrapnel Cannon, they erupt immediately.

Minion & Monster Kills grant 1 stack.
Damaging Enemy Heroes with abilties grants 5 stacks, once per activation.
Takedowns grant 20 stacks.
source_abilities.Q:
Launch a sticky mine that attaches to any Enemy Hero in its path, or any nearby Unit upon landing. 
After 2.5s, the mine explodes, dealing 90/120/150/180/210 (+70% magical power) magical damage.
Landing a Basic Attack against an Enemy with an attached Sticky Mine empowers it, dealing 110/150/190/230/270 (+95% magical power) magical damage instead.
Sticky Mines that attach to yourself or Allied Units are also empowered.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash Gadget's Tesla Dome, dealing 480/780/1080 (+220% magical power) magical damage over 5s to all Enemies caught within. 
Each instance of damage shreds the Target's magical armor by 3.5% for 3s and briefly Slows them by 50%.
Tesla Dome grows 60% larger over its initial lifetime.
source_abilities.RMB:
Release an airborne droid that can be reactivated mid-flight to stop it in place. 
Upon stopping, the droid will follow the nearest Enemy Hero beneath it, dealing 100/160/220/280/340 (+105% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area over 2.5s, and Slowing them by 20%.

patch_context.summary: Empowered mine damage and stronger allied gate movement help wave pressure and repositioning; the gate costs more mana. Retain the mana/spell path and avoid treating gate spam as free protection.

abilities.game_description: Ikra creates an Abyssal Bubble that Slows Enemies by 20% while they are in its radius. The Bubble can be popped by hitting it with either Fathom or Brine, dealing 35/45/55/65/75 (+15%) magical damage to all Targets in a 520 Unit radius and restoring 30 Mana. The Bubble amplifies after 1.1s, increasing the damage dealt to 75/120/165/210/255 (+80%) magical damage whilst Slowing all Targets hit by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1s. Popping a Bubble with Brine deals Brine's Damage as well as Hydroclasm's Damage. If the Bubble is amplified when popped by Brine, the total damage penetrates 40% of the Target's Magical Armor. Max Charges: 2

source_abilities.E:
Dash 475/525/575/625/675 units in your current movement direction, becoming briefly Unselectable and gaining an additional 5/10/15/20/25 Bonus Physical Power for 4s, stacking up to 5 times.
Cooldown Resets on Takedown.
source_abilities.Passive:
Nevermore activates every 15/14.5/14/13.5/13/12.5/12/11.5/11/10.5/10/9.5/9/8.5/8/7.5/7/6.5s (-0.5 per Level), empowering Kira.
While empowered, Kira's next Basic Attack or Mercy blast fires a Raven at the target that explodes on impact, dealing (+7% of the Target's Current Health) physical damage to all targets in a small area.
source_abilities.Q:
Passive: Apply Vengeance to enemies by dealing basic attack or ability damage, increasing damage you deal to them by 0.75% for 3.5s, stacking infinitely.
Active: Purify all Enemy Units afflicted with Vengeance, dealing 45/65/85/105/125 physical damage, plus an additional 6/8/10/12/14 (+12% physical power) damage per stack, and Slowing them by 10/15/20/25/30% for 1s.
The cooldown is reset if Dusk kills any target.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460% physical power) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s.
These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike.
While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.
source_abilities.RMB:
Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+74/78/82/86/90% physical power) physical damage and applying 3 stacks of Vengeance to the Target.
Mercy benefits from Lifesteal, can Critically Strike, and applies on-hit effects.

patch_context.summary: Dusk refunds mana only on a kill, once per cast; align last hits with poke. Mercy improves and physical scaling shifts later. Retain carry economy; do not promise free repeated casts or a new win-rate tier.

source_abilities.E:
Kwang dashes forward, becoming Unselectable and dealing 75/100/125/150/175 (+45% magical power) to all Enemy Units he passes through. 
When the Blade is in the world, if Kwang dashes within 300 units of its radius he will summon it back to his hand with a crash of lightning, dealing the damage to all nearby Enemy Units and Knocking them Up for 0.25s.
source_abilities.Passive:
When Kwang damages an Enemy with an ability his Heavenly Blade becomes Energized with electricity for 4s, stacking up to 3 times.
Whilst Energized, Kwang gains 45% attack speed and his next basic attack strikes lightning from above dealing 10/12/14/16/18/21/24/27/30/33/37/41/45/49/53/57/62/67 (+4 per level)(+20% magical power) magical damage to the Target and nearby Enemies. 
If this damages an Enemy Hero, Kwang reduces his basic ability cooldowns by 0.5s per stack.
source_abilities.Q:
Throw the Heavenly Blade at a target location to deal 90/115/140/165/190 (+40% magical power) magical damage.
Enemies hit by the Blade will be Tethered to it for 1.3s. 
When in the world, the Blade grants vision in a small area around it.
Recalling the Blade early will break the Tether.
source_abilities.R:
Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade, dealing 230/340/450 (+80% magical power) magical damage and applying a 45/55/65% Slow for 2s to nearby Enemy Units. 
If the Blade is in the world, Kwang will Teleport to it before striking.
source_abilities.RMB:
Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage to nearby Enemy Units. 
While holding the Blade, it deals 75/110/145/180/215 (+60% magical power)(+70% physical power) magical damage and grants Kwang a 65/95/125/155/185 (+40% magical power) (+9% health) Shield for 2.5s. 
If the Blade is in the world, it deals 90/125/160/195/230 (+80% magical power)(+80% physical power) true damage instead.

patch_context.summary: Sword retrieval now works while Grounded. That fix does not establish immunity for every movement action; retain ability/defense economy and inspect the exact tether condition.

source_abilities.E:
Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% physical power) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies. 
The Standard rallies nearby Allies for 8s if they remain within 1500 units. 
Allies gain 8% Movement Speed and heal for 5/8/11/14/17 (+100% physical penetration) (+10% magical power) Health every Second.
Additionally, Enemy Wards are Revealed.
Legion gains Infinite Ammo.
source_abilities.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 20/21.16/22.37/23.65/24.99/26.39/27.86/29.38/30.97/32.62/34.33/36.11/37.94/39.84/41.8/43.82/45.91/48.05 (+17% physical power) Physical Damage. This damage is increased by +1.35% per 1 Physical Penetration owned.
If Legion does not fire for 1.25 seconds, the rifle's ammo will gradually replenish.
When the magazine is empty, Legion reloads his rifle.
source_abilities.Passive:
Legion converts 1% Bonus Attack Speed into 0.75 Ability Haste.
Legion also gains bonuses based on purchased Item stats:
100 Physical Power: Saturation Charge Slow Duration increased by 0.75s.
30 Physical Penetration: Orbital Sanction's Radius is increased by 33%.
45 Ability Haste: Frag Order deals 10% of the Target's Missing Health as Physical Damage.
80 Magical Power: Rally Point's Heal is increased by 50%.
source_abilities.Q:
Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world, Enemies or by reactivation. 
Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Slows Enemies hit by 40% for 1s. 
Consecutive Mine hits on the same Enemy deal 25% Damage.
source_abilities.R:
Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, an Orbital Beam blasts the designated location, tracking Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes.
Enemy Targets within the blast take 30/50/70 (+26% physical power) (+10% magical power) Physical Damage every 0.25s. The Orbital Beam persists for 6/7.5/9s.
If there are no Enemy Targets within 2000 units, the blast remains stationary.
source_abilities.RMB:
Legion cooks a Grenade with a 2.2s fuse, reducing the time before detonation based on duration held. 
Throw the Grenade causing an explosion that deals 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Launches Legion or Enemies hit. The Grenade automatically explodes after 0.2s if it is near an Enemy.
When cooked for the full duration, it will explode in Legion's hand.
If Legion is Stunned, Killed or cancels the ability whilst cooking the Grenade, it drops to the floor.

patch_context.summary: Larger basic projectiles improve hit consistency. They do not increase listed damage or establish a measured DPS gain; retain the attack-dependent build.

primary.menu_description: Throw a hive of insects that explodes dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+65%) magical damage and Slowing targets hit by 50%, decaying over 3s.

secondary.menu_description: Become the swarm, gaining 50% decaying Movement Speed and 12% (+1.5%) Damage Reduction for 3.5s. Passing through Enemy Units deals 110/150/190/230/270 (+75%) magical damage and restores health equal to 30% of the pre-mitigated damage dealt. Healing is reduced by 75% against Minions. Swarm's effect is fully refreshed if it damages an Enemy Hero, and its duration is extended by 0.5s when colliding with Non-Heroes. Morigesh also gains an additional 25% Decaying Movement Speed over 1s when colliding with Non-Heroes.

ultimate.menu_description: After a brief channel, Summon a horde of insects to stab the Marked target, dealing 320/450/580 (+80%) magical damage. The Mark is removed upon casting this ability.

patch_context.skill_order_boundary: Official 1.17 headings conflict with the collected button mapping. Follow ability names in game; no 18-level button schedule is endorsed.

source_abilities.E:
Throw an orb that applies a 80/120/160/200/240 (+50% magical power) shield to the first Allied Hero it touches, granting them 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Decaying Movement Speed for 4s.
Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.
source_abilities.Passive:
Muriel's damaging abilities reduce Enemy Healing by 25/35/45% at Muriel levels 1/7/13 for 4s.
Allies affected by Muriel's abilities gain increased Healing and Shielding Received for 4s: 10% at the affected ally's level 1, plus 0.4 percentage points per level after the first, reaching 16.8% at level 18.
source_abilities.Q:
Sanctify the ground with an angelic light for 6s. 
Allies within the area gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Total Attack Speed and restore 60/80/100/120/140 (+20% magical power) Health over its lifetime.
Enemies within the area have their Total Attack Speed reduced by 10/11.5/13/14.5/16% and receive 90/120/150/180/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage over its lifetime.
source_abilities.R:
Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 30% Damage Reduction and a 280/480/680 (+100% magical power) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location.
On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100/160/220 (+40% magical power) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.
source_abilities.RMB:
Charge a piercing bolt of energy for up to 4s that deals 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slows by 35% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. 
If Muriel charges Serenity for 1.1s it reaches max charge and deals 98/147/196/245/294 (+70% magical power) magical damage and Stuns the target for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s instead.
If Muriel cancels the charge, 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the cost is refunded.
Projectile radius: 85. Projectile speed: 3900 (official patch-note values).

patch_context.summary: Less durability, shield scaling, passive protection and ultimate reduction make positioning more important. Consecrated Ground loses unintended extra output; do not subtract another 10% from already intended tooltip numbers. Hexbound/Transference utility costs rise. Ability-name guidance remains; button order is disputed.
