[p]Hello, Champions, and Happy New Year![/p][p align="start"]We haven’t seen you since last year, but luckily we haven’t had to wait long. The year has barely begun, and things are already falling into place for V1.11, arriving next Tuesday, January 13th![/p][p align="start"]And there are some rather exciting things waiting for you in this one![/p][p align="start"]Without further ado, let’s dive into:[/p][list][*][p]New Hero: Maco, a menace and a healer![/p][/*][*][p]New Year, better Nitro![/p][/*][*][p]AFK VP loss mitigation[/p][/*][*][p]Party Boost XP[/p][/*][*][p]Community Voted Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Forever Hero Pack[/p][/*][*][p]New skins[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]New Hero: Maco, the adorable menace[/h2][p align="start"]Predecessor Heroes can be many things: a special figure to their people, vigilantes who uphold justice, or warriors who have chosen the wrong path… Maco is none of them.[/p][p align="start"]It’s fair to say Maco is the hero of his own story. Like many of his kind - the Critterkin, inhabitants of Velrune’s forests and subterranean burrows - he loves to sleep, snack, and collect shiny things.[/p][p align="start"]As part of his duties, Maco was assigned to guard a shift so the rest of his family could sleep in peace. But his irresistible urge to try on the royal crown - the shiniest of objects - sent everything tumbling: the precious stones were lost, and the fear of a royal telling-off has now launched Maco on a grand quest to find replacement jewels. You can learn more about his story [url="https://www.predecessorgame.com/en-US/universe/stories/macos-magnificent-mishap"]here[/url].[/p][p align="start"]And that’s where we meet him: our new Support Hero, ready to heal you on the battlefield - and perhaps your soul, a little bit too.[/p][h3][b]Stats[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Health: 675 (+113 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Health Regen: 1.5 (+0.2 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Mana: 400 (+38 per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Regen: 2 (+0.12 per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Speed: 120 (+1.4 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Physical Armor: 22 (+4.3 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Magical Armor: 27 (+0.95 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Physical Power: 57 (+3.9 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Speed: 665[/p][/*][*][p]BAT: 1.2[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Abilities[/b][/h3][p][b]Mach Speed! \[Passive][/b][/p][p align="start"]As Maco moves, he gains stacks of Movement Speed up to 15% (+0.75% per level).[/p][p align="start"]When Maco reaches 25 stacks, he gains Mach Speed, which grants him Slow Immunity.[/p][p align="start"]After taking Damage from Enemy Heroes or standing still, he retains all buffs for 3s before they are removed.[/p][p]Ta-Da! \[Basic Attack][/p][p align="start"]Ranged basic attack dealing 57 (+55% Physical Power) physical damage.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, Maco gains a stack each time he successfully Basic Attacks an Enemy, up to a max of 4. At max stacks, Maco’s next ability’s Cooldown is reduced by 1s and all stacks are removed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maco Gift! \[Primary][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]7s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 50/75/100/125/150 Health[/p][p align="start"][b]Active:[/b] Maco lobs a gemstone that hurts or heals depending on the Target hit.[/p][p align="start"]If Maco hits an Ally, they are Healed for 50/70/80/110/130 (+35% Magical Power) Health in addition to 1/1.5/2/2.5/3% of their Max Health. Allies also gain 10/12/14/16/18% (+3% Magical Power) Movement Speed for 3s.[/p][p align="start"]If Maco hits an Enemy, they take 75/110/145/180/215 (+50% Magical Power) magical damage.[/p][p align="start"]Maco cannot hit himself with this ability.[/p][p align="start"][b]Passive:[/b] Hitting either Allied or Enemy Heroes with any ability Heals you for 20/30/40/50/60 (+2% Magical Power) (+0.3% Max Health) Health.[/p][p align="start"]Using this ability costs Health instead of Mana.[/p][p]
[b]Maco Fly! \[Secondary][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]16/15.25/14.5/13.75/13s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost: [/b]80/85/90/95/100[/p][p align="start"]Maco leaps high into the air before slamming back down to the ground with his gemstone, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+85% Magical Power) magical damage to Enemies and Slowing them by 25% (+3% Magical Power) for 1.5s.[/p][p align="start"]If Maco hits an Enemy Hero, he gains a 80/135/190/245/300 (+40% Magical Power) (+7.5% Max Health) Health Shield for 4.5s.[/p][p align="start"]After landing, Maco dashes slightly in the direction he is currently moving.[/p][p]
[b]Maco Sparkle! \[Alternate][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]13/12.5/12/11.5/11s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 70/75/80/85/90[/p][p align="start"]Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability.[/p][p align="start"]When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% Magical Power) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s.[/p][p align="start"]Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s based on distance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maco Strike! \[Ultimate][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD:[/b] 115/95/75s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost: [/b]150[/p][p align="start"]Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels.[/p][p align="start"]When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 80/130/180 (+40% Magical Power) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it.[/p][p align="start"]At the gemstone’s max range, it explodes, dealing 120/195/270 (+70% Magical Power) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 1s.[/p][h3][b]Augments[/b][/h3][quote][p][b]Longshot:
[/b]- Related Ability: Alternate
- Type: Ability Damage
- Effect: Maco Sparkle’s damage scales linearly based on how far it travels from 100% to 200% damage.[/p][/quote][quote][p][b]Shatterbloom
[/b]- Related Ability: Ultimate
- Type: Healing
- Effect: Maco Strike creates a Healing field at the explosion location that Heals 15/25/35 (+4% Magical Power) every 0.25s for 5s.[/p][/quote][quote][p][b]Ferocious Flight[/b]
- Related Ability: Secondary
- Type: Shielding
- Effect: For each Enemy hit by Maco Fly, Maco gains 40/60/80/100/120 (+12.5% Magical Power) (+1.5% Max Health) additional Shielding and the ability’s Cooldown is reduced by 1s. This effect also occurs on non-Heroes but is reduced by 80%.[/p][/quote][h2]Have your say - Results[/h2][p align="start"]When we decided to dedicate V1.11 to small fixes with a big impact, we knew we didn’t just want to rely on our internal view of the game’s most-needed improvements - we wanted to involve you, our community, as well![/p][p align="start"]During a 10-day period in early November, you were able to submit issues in a dedicated Discord channel, where others could upvote or downvote each entry.[/p][p align="start"]We’ve compiled, analysed, and reviewed all the feedback, and assessed what we could squeeze into 1.11, considering the resources available - especially with the holiday season approaching. Additionally, we wanted to ensure that the proposed changes aligned with our goal of prioritizing adjustments with a big impact.[/p][p align="start"]This entire process has given us valuable insights into which Quality of Life changes are important to you. We’ve prepared a list of what we’ll be addressing in V1.11, as well as the things that we are aiming to ship in future releases later in 2026 and beyond.[/p][h3][b]Feedback We’ll Be Acting On in V1.11[/b][/h3][p][b]Adjustment of Tower Hitboxes[/b][/p][p align="start"]We heard the feedback that the hitboxes of towers don’t align properly with their actual shape. We’ll be adjusting this in V1.11 to improve aiming precision and fairness while engaging with the towers.[/p][p]Show Who Killed Fangtooth/Orb Prime[/p][p align="start"]A popular request that’s quick enough to implement - notifications for Fangtooth and Orb Prime will now include the name of the player who dealt the fatal blow. We’ll also let you know if the objective was stolen… just in case that information comes in handy for any revenge plans.[/p][p][b]Ranked Changes[/b][/p][p align="start"]Ranked is another part of the game that’s highly dynamic and frequently evolving, and it received its fair share of requests. We want to let you know that several of your requested changes to Ranked are being implemented in V1.11! You can find the exact breakdown of changes in the Ranked section.[/p][p][b]Play Any Hero in Practice[/b][/p][p align="start"]Starting in V1.11, you will be able to play any Hero in Practice mode, without needing to purchase them first![/p][p align="start"]This change will hopefully allow you to find Hero fitting your playstyle more easily, test them more thoroughly and allow you to make better informed decisions before spending Amber or Platinum on them.[/p][p][b]Social Screen Improvements[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’re adding more at-a-glance information about your Predecessor friends! When you select a friend in the Friends List, you’ll see their level, rank, and VP displayed at the top of the options menu (where you can mute/unmute, remove friend, etc.).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/78722bd7f3105dbf994386ec1579f4ff37106187.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Ultimate Hero Pack: Every Hero, Now and Forever[/b][/p][p align="start"]One of the most commonly requested features, especially for new players is the option to buy all of our Heroes in one go.[/p][p align="start"]We’re delighted to announce that we’re launching our Ultimate Hero Pack on the 21st of January, which instantly grants you access to our entire roster of currently available Heroes, plus every single new Hero we release in the future, at no additional cost.[/p][p align="start"]The bundle will launch with a 33% discount for $19.99 for the first 2 weeks until the 4th of February then returning to $29.99. The discount is only available on Steam, Epic and PSN stores due to platform restrictions.[/p][p align="start"]What’s included:[/p][list][*][p]Instant Access: Every currently playable Hero is unlocked immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Lifetime Value: All future Heroes are automatically added to your collection at release.[/p][/*][*][p]Amber Refunds: Get an Amber refund for every Hero you already unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This is a one-time purchase, all Heroes are permanently unlocked on your account. When a new Hero enters the fray, they will be waiting for you in your collection, no grinding required.[/p][p align="start"]Note: Amber refunds are granted for previously unlocked Heroes using their current Amber value.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Priorities For Us To Address In Future Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We received many excellent suggestions for new Quality of Life features, but some of them fall outside the scope of what we could realistically achieve in time for V1.11.[/p][p align="start"]The following is a list of features we’re hoping to bring to the game at a later date - [b][u]they are not included in V1.11.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Stability Improvements[/b][/p][p align="start"]We have some major performance and stability fixes coming to the game (including quite a few for the PlayStation version - watch this space). They still need a bit more work before they’re ready to ship, but you can expect them soon - over the next few weeks.
[/p][p][b]Daily and Weekly Challenges[/b][/p][p align="start"]You’ve asked for challenges to give you goals to work towards, and we get it! In fact, we’ve done a lot of groundwork for this feature already, but it still requires some additional time before we can consider it ready. However, now that we know just how much you’re looking forward to this feature, we’re hopeful it won’t be long before we’re able to introduce it to Predecessor.
[/p][p][b]Different Crosshairs for Different Heroes[/b][/p][p align="start"]Another highly requested feature, particularly for Heroes like Revenant, Murdock, and Bayle. While it’s a great idea, it unfortunately didn’t fit within the scope of this update. Fear not, this request will very much stay on our minds for the future!
[/p][p][b]Post-Match & Replay Build Visibility[/b][/p][p align="start"]Many of you upvoted the suggestions that pertained to the end of the match screen and replays - and one of the most popular ones asked for the ability to view player builds at the end of a match, while watching replays. We fully agree that this would improve the end of a match experience and would help learning experience. We are currently discussing the whole end of match experience because we think we can make several improvements there, and this will likely be part of that future work.
[/p][p][b]Hero Customization Page[/b][/p][p align="start"]A popular suggestion to create a hero customization tab in the main menu, where players could adjust keybinds, cosmetics, and builds. This is an excellent idea, and something we’d love to work on in the future.
[/p][p][b]Limiting Paragon Rank to 100 Players[/b][/p][p align="start"]We heard your feedback on increasing the prestige of the highest rank by strictly limiting it to a small number of players. We like that idea, we believe it makes plenty of sense, however, other Ranked system changes need to happen first before we can introduce this one, so this isn’t something we’ll be addressing in V1.11.
[/p][p][b]Switching Heroes in Practice Mode[/b][/p][p align="start"]You’ve asked for the ability to switch Heroes without leaving practice mode. We sympathize with this, it would be a great QoL feature! This requires some work though before we can introduce it, more work that we could fit in before V1.11.
[/p][p][b]Fog in the Jungle (from Shadows Eve Map)[/b][/p][p align="start"]This small visual effect, serving little more function than being a spooky flourish on the Shadow’s Eve map, has clearly charmed many of you, as it was one of the more popular suggestions. While we won’t be reintroducing it in V1.11, we wanted you to know that we’ve heard your request and will keep it in mind for the future especially in the design for our new map.
[/p][p][b]Ranked Matchmaking Improvements - Coming Soon[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’re still working on a major improvement to the matchmaking system, one that blends VP and our internal MMR much more effectively when creating matches. It isn’t quite ready yet, but we’re hoping to ship it before the current split ends, so watch this space.[/p][h2]
Ranked News[/h2][h3][b]Ranked Mode is Expanding![/b][/h3][p][b]SA[/b][/p][p align="start"]You really showed up, SA players! Ever since we launched Ranked in SA, we’ve been seeing awesome results, so based on the data, we’re happy to announce that SA Ranked will now be available every day![/p][p align="start"]Starting January 13, on weekdays (Monday–Friday), Ranked will be open from 17:00 BRT (20:00 UTC) until 00:00 BRT (03:00 UTC). Weekend windows will remain unchanged.[/p][p][/p][p][b]OCE & ASIA Ranked Test[/b][/p][p align="start"]The time has come - we want to test Ranked viability on OCE and ASIA servers![/p][p align="start"]Please keep in mind that, for now, this is only a test that we plan to run for a few weeks. We may extend it if we see good results and healthy queues, but we may also end it early if Ranked negatively impacts matchmaking in those regions.[/p][p align="start"][b]OCE - [/b]Starting Saturday, January 10, Ranked will be open on OCE from 20:00 AEDT (09:00 UTC) until 00:00 AEDT (13:00 UTC).[/p][p align="start"][b]ASIA - [/b]Starting Saturday, January 10, Ranked will be open on ASIA from 22:00 JST (13:00 UTC) until 02:00 JST (16:00 UTC).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ranked AFK VP Mitigation[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This feature is a popular request from Ranked players. It isn’t entirely new to the game - back in V1.5, we introduced the first iteration of VP Loss Mitigation, reducing the amount of VP lost in Ranked when one or more teammates were confirmed AFK by the game.[/p][p align="start"]However, the game didn’t communicate this clearly enough to players, and as we monitored the feature, we found that, overall, the reduction often wasn’t significant enough to make a meaningful difference.[/p][p align="start"]To address that, in V1.11 we’re introducing a notification on the Ranked VP screen whenever VP loss has been mitigated due to an AFK detection. We’ll also be increasing the amount of VP we mitigate, to between 60% and 80%, depending on match length.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Nitro Updates[/h2][p align="start"]Nitro remains one of our most popular game modes, and as we’ve said many times, we’re committed to making it the fastest mode available in Predecessor.[/p][p align="start"]The original goal for the mode was to deliver all the signature MOBA depth you love but in a much quicker game time. We’ve been iterating over time, with the most recent tweaks in 1.10 included, but we still felt like not having a game being guaranteed to finish before 20 mins meant that we weren’t delivering on our original goal.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Introducing Last Stand[/b][/p][p align="start"]Last Stand begins at 16 minutes. When it starts, all remaining towers and inhibitors ignite and begin to burn, losing health every second. Once a structure reaches 1 HP, it will stop taking damage from the fire, at that point, it must be finished off by a Hero or minions to be destroyed.[/p][p align="start"]The Core will also take damage from the fire, but only down to 50% health.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, we’ve rebalanced the late-game consumable potions. They’ll now be available from level 15+ and will cost X onwards, providing a massive stat boost for 3 minutes.[/p][p align="start"]Both changes are aimed at ensuring games finish before 20 minutes. Hopefully, that goal will finally be realized - we’re excited to find out!We’ve been playtesting these changes for a while and we’re excited about opening them up to all players.[/p][p align="start"]As always, we’ll continue to keep an eye on their impact, as we look to deliver on a consistent sub 20 minute game time, without the mode losing the depth that makes MOBAs special. Please let us know what you think of the changes as you play Nitro over the next few weeks.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Party XP Boost[/h2][p align="start"]In V1.11, playing with friends is really going to pay off! To encourage partying up, players who enter matchmaking as a premade party will receive an additional XP boost, helping you progress even faster. It’s the perfect opportunity to help new friends level up - or to speed up your own grind to the top![/p][p align="start"]The boost starts as soon as you queue with one other person: you’ll receive 10% extra XP with a party of 2, plus an additional 10% for each extra party member, up to a whopping 40% when the party is full.[/p][p align="start"]This boost is available across all game modes, and there’s no minimum level and no level cap: it’s open to everyone, always![/p][p align="start"]There’s never been a better time to introduce your friends to Predecessor -or to use LFG channels.[/p][h2]
Store News[/h2][h3][b]Skins[/b][/h3][p][b]Infernix Greystone (Epic)[/b][/p][p align="start"]A menacing and rather sharp rendition of your favourite paladin, straight from high-tech hell. [i]This skin features updated voiceover.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/c21abcb6126881e1c9df1961318eb53e91f20f5e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Infernix Kallari (Epic)[/b][/p][p align="start"]Kallari didn’t need to be even more ravaging. Well, she is now, and all of us need to deal with consequences. [i]This skin features updated voiceover.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/0726d63dffa5aabbd7ca649b1973fe0e5f0ebc03.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Infernix Countess (Rare)[/b][/p][p align="start"]Very silent, very wise, deadly in the darkness… is it an owl? No, it’s Countess.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/dea16a4781e8765ac5aad3a4b7f5219e9e779166.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Apocalyptic Maco (Rare)[/b][/p][p align="start"]If it’s the end times, you can bet Maco will keep on rolling - as a one-Critterkin bike gang.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/6a07cccf4f3e9ce1f3f088fc6c2c10be04115f56.jpg"][/img]

entries.text:
Hello, Champions, and Happy New Year!

We haven’t seen you since last year, but luckily we haven’t had to wait long. The year has barely begun, and things are already falling into place for V1.11, arriving next Tuesday, January 13th!

And there are some rather exciting things waiting for you in this one!

Without further ado, let’s dive into:

New Hero: Maco, a menace and a healer!

New Year, better Nitro!

AFK VP loss mitigation

Party Boost XP

Community Voted Fixes

Forever Hero Pack

New skins

And more!

New Hero: Maco, the adorable menace

Predecessor Heroes can be many things: a special figure to their people, vigilantes who uphold justice, or warriors who have chosen the wrong path… Maco is none of them.

It’s fair to say Maco is the hero of his own story. Like many of his kind - the Critterkin, inhabitants of Velrune’s forests and subterranean burrows - he loves to sleep, snack, and collect shiny things.

As part of his duties, Maco was assigned to guard a shift so the rest of his family could sleep in peace. But his irresistible urge to try on the royal crown - the shiniest of objects - sent everything tumbling: the precious stones were lost, and the fear of a royal telling-off has now launched Maco on a grand quest to find replacement jewels. You can learn more about his story here.

And that’s where we meet him: our new Support Hero, ready to heal you on the battlefield - and perhaps your soul, a little bit too.

Stats

Health: 675 (+113 per Level)

Health Regen: 1.5 (+0.2 per Level)

Mana: 400 (+38 per level)

Mana Regen: 2 (+0.12 per level)

Attack Speed: 120 (+1.4 per Level)

Physical Armor: 22 (+4.3 per Level)

Magical Armor: 27 (+0.95 per Level)

Physical Power: 57 (+3.9 per Level)

Movement Speed: 665

BAT: 1.2

Abilities

Mach Speed! \

As Maco moves, he gains stacks of Movement Speed up to 15% (+0.75% per level).

When Maco reaches 25 stacks, he gains Mach Speed, which grants him Slow Immunity.

After taking Damage from Enemy Heroes or standing still, he retains all buffs for 3s before they are removed.

Ta-Da! \

Ranged basic attack dealing 57 (+55% Physical Power) physical damage.

Additionally, Maco gains a stack each time he successfully Basic Attacks an Enemy, up to a max of 4. At max stacks, Maco’s next ability’s Cooldown is reduced by 1s and all stacks are removed.

Maco Gift! \

CD: 7s

Cost: 50/75/100/125/150 Health

Active: Maco lobs a gemstone that hurts or heals depending on the Target hit.

If Maco hits an Ally, they are Healed for 50/70/80/110/130 (+35% Magical Power) Health in addition to 1/1.5/2/2.5/3% of their Max Health. Allies also gain 10/12/14/16/18% (+3% Magical Power) Movement Speed for 3s.

If Maco hits an Enemy, they take 75/110/145/180/215 (+50% Magical Power) magical damage.

Maco cannot hit himself with this ability.

Passive: Hitting either Allied or Enemy Heroes with any ability Heals you for 20/30/40/50/60 (+2% Magical Power) (+0.3% Max Health) Health.

Using this ability costs Health instead of Mana.

Maco Fly! \

CD: 16/15.25/14.5/13.75/13s

Cost: 80/85/90/95/100

Maco leaps high into the air before slamming back down to the ground with his gemstone, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+85% Magical Power) magical damage to Enemies and Slowing them by 25% (+3% Magical Power) for 1.5s.

If Maco hits an Enemy Hero, he gains a 80/135/190/245/300 (+40% Magical Power) (+7.5% Max Health) Health Shield for 4.5s.

After landing, Maco dashes slightly in the direction he is currently moving.

Maco Sparkle! \

CD: 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s

Cost: 70/75/80/85/90

Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability.

When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% Magical Power) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s.

Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s based on distance.

Maco Strike! \

CD: 115/95/75s

Cost: 150

Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels.

When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 80/130/180 (+40% Magical Power) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it.

At the gemstone’s max range, it explodes, dealing 120/195/270 (+70% Magical Power) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 1s.

Augments

Longshot:
- Related Ability: Alternate
- Type: Ability Damage
- Effect: Maco Sparkle’s damage scales linearly based on how far it travels from 100% to 200% damage.

Shatterbloom
- Related Ability: Ultimate
- Type: Healing
- Effect: Maco Strike creates a Healing field at the explosion location that Heals 15/25/35 (+4% Magical Power) every 0.25s for 5s.

Ferocious Flight
- Related Ability: Secondary
- Type: Shielding
- Effect: For each Enemy hit by Maco Fly, Maco gains 40/60/80/100/120 (+12.5% Magical Power) (+1.5% Max Health) additional Shielding and the ability’s Cooldown is reduced by 1s. This effect also occurs on non-Heroes but is reduced by 80%.

Have your say - Results

When we decided to dedicate V1.11 to small fixes with a big impact, we knew we didn’t just want to rely on our internal view of the game’s most-needed improvements - we wanted to involve you, our community, as well!

During a 10-day period in early November, you were able to submit issues in a dedicated Discord channel, where others could upvote or downvote each entry.

We’ve compiled, analysed, and reviewed all the feedback, and assessed what we could squeeze into 1.11, considering the resources available - especially with the holiday season approaching. Additionally, we wanted to ensure that the proposed changes aligned with our goal of prioritizing adjustments with a big impact.

This entire process has given us valuable insights into which Quality of Life changes are important to you. We’ve prepared a list of what we’ll be addressing in V1.11, as well as the things that we are aiming to ship in future releases later in 2026 and beyond.

Feedback We’ll Be Acting On in V1.11

Adjustment of Tower Hitboxes

We heard the feedback that the hitboxes of towers don’t align properly with their actual shape. We’ll be adjusting this in V1.11 to improve aiming precision and fairness while engaging with the towers.

Show Who Killed Fangtooth/Orb Prime

A popular request that’s quick enough to implement - notifications for Fangtooth and Orb Prime will now include the name of the player who dealt the fatal blow. We’ll also let you know if the objective was stolen… just in case that information comes in handy for any revenge plans.

Ranked Changes

Ranked is another part of the game that’s highly dynamic and frequently evolving, and it received its fair share of requests. We want to let you know that several of your requested changes to Ranked are being implemented in V1.11! You can find the exact breakdown of changes in the Ranked section.

Play Any Hero in Practice

Starting in V1.11, you will be able to play any Hero in Practice mode, without needing to purchase them first!

This change will hopefully allow you to find Hero fitting your playstyle more easily, test them more thoroughly and allow you to make better informed decisions before spending Amber or Platinum on them.

Social Screen Improvements

We’re adding more at-a-glance information about your Predecessor friends! When you select a friend in the Friends List, you’ll see their level, rank, and VP displayed at the top of the options menu (where you can mute/unmute, remove friend, etc.).

The Ultimate Hero Pack: Every Hero, Now and Forever

One of the most commonly requested features, especially for new players is the option to buy all of our Heroes in one go.

We’re delighted to announce that we’re launching our Ultimate Hero Pack on the 21st of January, which instantly grants you access to our entire roster of currently available Heroes, plus every single new Hero we release in the future, at no additional cost.

The bundle will launch with a 33% discount for $19.99 for the first 2 weeks until the 4th of February then returning to $29.99. The discount is only available on Steam, Epic and PSN stores due to platform restrictions.

What’s included:

Instant Access: Every currently playable Hero is unlocked immediately.

Lifetime Value: All future Heroes are automatically added to your collection at release.

Amber Refunds: Get an Amber refund for every Hero you already unlocked.

This is a one-time purchase, all Heroes are permanently unlocked on your account. When a new Hero enters the fray, they will be waiting for you in your collection, no grinding required.

Note: Amber refunds are granted for previously unlocked Heroes using their current Amber value.

Priorities For Us To Address In Future Updates

We received many excellent suggestions for new Quality of Life features, but some of them fall outside the scope of what we could realistically achieve in time for V1.11.

The following is a list of features we’re hoping to bring to the game at a later date - they are not included in V1.11.

Stability Improvements

We have some major performance and stability fixes coming to the game (including quite a few for the PlayStation version - watch this space). They still need a bit more work before they’re ready to ship, but you can expect them soon - over the next few weeks.

Daily and Weekly Challenges

You’ve asked for challenges to give you goals to work towards, and we get it! In fact, we’ve done a lot of groundwork for this feature already, but it still requires some additional time before we can consider it ready. However, now that we know just how much you’re looking forward to this feature, we’re hopeful it won’t be long before we’re able to introduce it to Predecessor.

Different Crosshairs for Different Heroes

Another highly requested feature, particularly for Heroes like Revenant, Murdock, and Bayle. While it’s a great idea, it unfortunately didn’t fit within the scope of this update. Fear not, this request will very much stay on our minds for the future!

Post-Match & Replay Build Visibility

Many of you upvoted the suggestions that pertained to the end of the match screen and replays - and one of the most popular ones asked for the ability to view player builds at the end of a match, while watching replays. We fully agree that this would improve the end of a match experience and would help learning experience. We are currently discussing the whole end of match experience because we think we can make several improvements there, and this will likely be part of that future work.

Hero Customization Page

A popular suggestion to create a hero customization tab in the main menu, where players could adjust keybinds, cosmetics, and builds. This is an excellent idea, and something we’d love to work on in the future.

Limiting Paragon Rank to 100 Players

We heard your feedback on increasing the prestige of the highest rank by strictly limiting it to a small number of players. We like that idea, we believe it makes plenty of sense, however, other Ranked system changes need to happen first before we can introduce this one, so this isn’t something we’ll be addressing in V1.11.

Switching Heroes in Practice Mode

You’ve asked for the ability to switch Heroes without leaving practice mode. We sympathize with this, it would be a great QoL feature! This requires some work though before we can introduce it, more work that we could fit in before V1.11.

Fog in the Jungle (from Shadows Eve Map)

This small visual effect, serving little more function than being a spooky flourish on the Shadow’s Eve map, has clearly charmed many of you, as it was one of the more popular suggestions. While we won’t be reintroducing it in V1.11, we wanted you to know that we’ve heard your request and will keep it in mind for the future especially in the design for our new map.

Ranked Matchmaking Improvements - Coming Soon

We’re still working on a major improvement to the matchmaking system, one that blends VP and our internal MMR much more effectively when creating matches. It isn’t quite ready yet, but we’re hoping to ship it before the current split ends, so watch this space.

Ranked News

Ranked Mode is Expanding!

SA

You really showed up, SA players! Ever since we launched Ranked in SA, we’ve been seeing awesome results, so based on the data, we’re happy to announce that SA Ranked will now be available every day!

Starting January 13, on weekdays (Monday–Friday), Ranked will be open from 17:00 BRT (20:00 UTC) until 00:00 BRT (03:00 UTC). Weekend windows will remain unchanged.

OCE & ASIA Ranked Test

The time has come - we want to test Ranked viability on OCE and ASIA servers!

Please keep in mind that, for now, this is only a test that we plan to run for a few weeks. We may extend it if we see good results and healthy queues, but we may also end it early if Ranked negatively impacts matchmaking in those regions.

OCE - Starting Saturday, January 10, Ranked will be open on OCE from 20:00 AEDT (09:00 UTC) until 00:00 AEDT (13:00 UTC).

ASIA - Starting Saturday, January 10, Ranked will be open on ASIA from 22:00 JST (13:00 UTC) until 02:00 JST (16:00 UTC).

Ranked AFK VP Mitigation

This feature is a popular request from Ranked players. It isn’t entirely new to the game - back in V1.5, we introduced the first iteration of VP Loss Mitigation, reducing the amount of VP lost in Ranked when one or more teammates were confirmed AFK by the game.

However, the game didn’t communicate this clearly enough to players, and as we monitored the feature, we found that, overall, the reduction often wasn’t significant enough to make a meaningful difference.

To address that, in V1.11 we’re introducing a notification on the Ranked VP screen whenever VP loss has been mitigated due to an AFK detection. We’ll also be increasing the amount of VP we mitigate, to between 60% and 80%, depending on match length.

Nitro Updates

Nitro remains one of our most popular game modes, and as we’ve said many times, we’re committed to making it the fastest mode available in Predecessor.

The original goal for the mode was to deliver all the signature MOBA depth you love but in a much quicker game time. We’ve been iterating over time, with the most recent tweaks in 1.10 included, but we still felt like not having a game being guaranteed to finish before 20 mins meant that we weren’t delivering on our original goal.

Introducing Last Stand

Last Stand begins at 16 minutes. When it starts, all remaining towers and inhibitors ignite and begin to burn, losing health every second. Once a structure reaches 1 HP, it will stop taking damage from the fire, at that point, it must be finished off by a Hero or minions to be destroyed.

The Core will also take damage from the fire, but only down to 50% health.

Additionally, we’ve rebalanced the late-game consumable potions. They’ll now be available from level 15+ and will cost X onwards, providing a massive stat boost for 3 minutes.

Both changes are aimed at ensuring games finish before 20 minutes. Hopefully, that goal will finally be realized - we’re excited to find out!We’ve been playtesting these changes for a while and we’re excited about opening them up to all players.

As always, we’ll continue to keep an eye on their impact, as we look to deliver on a consistent sub 20 minute game time, without the mode losing the depth that makes MOBAs special. Please let us know what you think of the changes as you play Nitro over the next few weeks.

Party XP Boost

In V1.11, playing with friends is really going to pay off! To encourage partying up, players who enter matchmaking as a premade party will receive an additional XP boost, helping you progress even faster. It’s the perfect opportunity to help new friends level up - or to speed up your own grind to the top!

The boost starts as soon as you queue with one other person: you’ll receive 10% extra XP with a party of 2, plus an additional 10% for each extra party member, up to a whopping 40% when the party is full.

This boost is available across all game modes, and there’s no minimum level and no level cap: it’s open to everyone, always!

There’s never been a better time to introduce your friends to Predecessor -or to use LFG channels.

Store News

Skins

Infernix Greystone (Epic)

A menacing and rather sharp rendition of your favourite paladin, straight from high-tech hell. This skin features updated voiceover.

Infernix Kallari (Epic)

Kallari didn’t need to be even more ravaging. Well, she is now, and all of us need to deal with consequences. This skin features updated voiceover.

Infernix Countess (Rare)

Very silent, very wise, deadly in the darkness… is it an owl? No, it’s Countess.

Apocalyptic Maco (Rare)

If it’s the end times, you can bet Maco will keep on rolling - as a one-Critterkin bike gang.

coverage.reason: Anomaly is correctly damage over time and no longer interrupts recalls. Do not recommend recall denial from it; the kit still needs its normal combo execution.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Steel’s Heavy Metal Augment allowed his Basic Attacks to destroy Spell Shield Effects.
coverage.reason: Heavy Metal basics no longer remove spell shields. Keep an actual spell-shield answer before the engage. Immobilizing Valmont can break his tether, then Shield Slam can set up allied area damage without pushing victims out.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Morigesh’s Spiritcaller Skin that would cause her headdress and loincloth to be invisible when viewed from behind.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Hero AI where they could spam debug location errors into the in-game chat if they become stuck.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed the stat-tracking of various items to function correctly (Noxia, Caustica, Overseer, Spellblade Items, Mutilator, Frosted Lure, Manta Scythe, Nightfall).
coverage.reason: Observed item tracking becomes more reliable; no damage multiplier or recommendation score is invented.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Disabled Eternal Blessings could still be selected via a Loadout.
coverage.reason: A disabled blessing cannot be endorsed because it remains selectable in an old saved loadout. Future disable notices invalidate affected review dependencies.

coverage.change: Fixed various texture issues with Terra’s Guardian Skin.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Serath’s Heaven’s Fury could prevent her from taking damage when in the Enemy Team’s Fountain.
coverage.reason: Physical attack scaling rises while secondary on-hit scaling and ultimate burn fall. Retain the physical sustained-contact route; Weald proc-trigger fix partially offsets its minor-blessing nerfs. Valmont attack-speed theft matters only if tether connects; allied immobilization can break it.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Epoch’s Stasis Effect would prevent the User from taking damage from the Enemy Team’s Fountain until they leave.
coverage.reason: Fountain interactions corrected; no strategy is based on exploiting fountain damage or invulnerability.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Greystone could be killed by the Enemy Team’s Fountain when using his Ultimate.
coverage.reason: Lower health and armor growth favor earlier real defense. Jungle now buys Giant's Ring before Basilisk; magic defense can come first against the actual threat. Fountain fixes are not general invulnerability.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Akeron would take double damage from the Enemy Team’s Fountain.
coverage.reason: Lower magic scaling and slightly greater health scaling favor the existing durable tank path over converting him into a burst mage. Support remains experimental; do not borrow offlane/jungle outcomes.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Scarlett could Blink in place while using her Ultimate.
coverage.reason: The in-place Blink during ultimate is fixed. This is a reliability change, not extra damage or a guaranteed escape through control.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Numerical Minimap Timers could fail to appear for Fangtooth and Orb Prime.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Owned Items could be gifted in regions where Gifting is disabled.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where a Loot Core’s “Open” prompt could swap to “Gift”.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Crunch’s Passive would display the incorrect Stack number on the Ability Bar.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Renna’s Healthbar would snap down briefly after she teleports with her Ultimate.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Florescence was described as a “Cleanse” Effect.
coverage.reason: Do not describe Florescence as a cleanse; only its verified source mechanic can justify an item/loadout choice.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Akeron’s Crushing Maw would not display a HUD Debuff for the affected target.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Gideon’s Cosmic Rift would not display a HUD Notifier for the duration of the effect.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Spell Shield effects could be triggered while under the effect of Epoch’s Stasis.
coverage.reason: Do not count a spell-shield trigger during Epoch stasis; do not assume Steel basics consume a shield.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue where Serath’s Heresy displayed the incorrect damage type icon on its upgrade window.
coverage.reason: No build-power adjustment; UI/cosmetic correction in the game, not a change to this app.

coverage.change: Fixed Valmont Emote having no VO
coverage.reason: Emote voice line only; no gameplay effect.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Valmont's Sanguine Banquet regenerating mana incorrectly
coverage.reason: The hotfix does not describe the incorrect behaviour or its direction. The reviewed Valmont plan and loadout quote the official launch text (2% (+0.5% Bonus Mana) Omnivamp; +2 maximum mana per nearby minion death, +30 per hero death), which the hotfix does not change, and no reviewed advice depends on mana regeneration from this augment. No numerical performance effect is inferred.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Valmont's Passive Description
coverage.reason: Description text fix. Reviewed Valmont text comes from the official 1.17 kit, which this hotfix does not change; source-text differences remain governed by source reconciliation.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with the Crown Placement on Valmont's Unleashed skin
coverage.reason: Skin crown placement only; no gameplay effect.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Victorious banner having incorrect drop shadow
coverage.reason: Banner drop shadow only; no gameplay effect.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Crucible wins not being tracked on Quests
coverage.reason: Crucible wins now count for quests; progression tracking, not match performance.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Gideon's Black Hole pulling enemies if interrupted on cast
coverage.reason: An interrupted cast no longer pulls enemies. Reviewed Gideon advice already says to interrupt Black Hole before its 2.75s channel completes and to protect Gideon during it; the fix makes that interrupt advice more reliable and contradicts none of it. No numerical performance effect is inferred.

coverage.change: Fixed an issue with Gideon's Mana bar reflecting incorrect values on remote perspective
coverage.reason: Mana bar shown to other players only; no gameplay effect.

coverage.change: Fixed various issues with Localisation
coverage.reason: Text localisation only; no gameplay effect.

limitations: Statz still labels the statistical dataset 1.16. Fresh collection does not establish a 1.17 match cohort. No Valmont sample is invented.
Gold+ is the editorial reference; six bracket samples remain separate. Public Pred.gg is optional and access stops are respected.
Tier grades, pair outcome comparisons and complete composition rankings are not newly proven by patch notes. Previous dated guidance remains available.

Muriel button mapping conflicts between official 1.17 headings and the source kit. Exact button allocation remains unavailable until confirmed. Wukong exceptional skill ranks are not replaced with a generic schedule.
Lilith inherits attack speed; her interaction with every item on-hit is unverified. The Valmont starter does not depend on pet on-hit triggers.

Observed 1.17 rates include games played before Hotfix 1.17.1 (24 Sep), when Sanguine Banquet's mana regeneration and Black Hole's interrupted cast behaved incorrectly. Rates are shown as observed; Valmont and Gideon grades are rechecked in the planned follow-up review.

abilities.simplifiedDescription: Slash through Enemies with your thorn covered sword Acacia.

abilities.menuDescription: Adele unfurls her Sword in a straight line, dealing 40/55/70/85/100 (+80%) true damage to all Enemies it passes through. If she hits an Enemy Hero or Monster, they are Rooted for 0.6s and Adele dashes to the furthest target hit.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Unfurl your Sword in a long line, dealing True Damage to all Enemies it passes through. Hitting an Enemy Hero or Monster Roots them and causes you to dash to the furthest target hit.

abilities.menuDescription: Adele swings her sword, gaining 40% Movement Speed for the duration.. She deals 5/20/35/50/65 (+50/60/70/80/90%) physical damage twice to nearby Enemies and Mesmerizes them for 1s. Mesmerized Enemies are immune to Slows. Adele then slams her sword down in an area to deal 60/80/100/120/140 (+8%) true damage to all Enemies hit.
abilities.simplifiedDescription:
Spin twice slashing your sword, dealing damage, gaining Movement Speed and Mesmerizing nearby Enemies. 
Then slam the ground, dealing True Damage.

abilities.menuDescription: Adele equips her shield for 4.5s, increasing her hitbox size and gaining 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% (+4%)(+4%) Damage Reduction. This can be cast during other abilities. On cast, she attaches a Thorned Vine to Enemy Heroes and Monsters within 800u. The Vine deals 6/8/10/12/14 (+0.7%) true damage every 0.5s for the duration. The Vine snaps if an Enemy moves more than 1000u away.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Summon your shield and a barrier, increasing your hitbox and gaining Damage Reduction. Simultaneously attach Vines to nearby Enemies, dealing True Damage over time.

abilities.menuDescription: Adele performs a small leap, slamming her shield into the ground, summoning a large Thornbush at her location for 8s. Vines attach to all Enemies within the central section, dealing 55/90/125 (+5%) physical damage. This Interrupts abilities, Roots Enemies for 0.5s, and pulls flying Enemies to the ground. All Enemies inside the Thornbush are Slowed by 35/37.5/40% and take 4/7/10 true damage every 35u moved within it.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Leap up and slam shield down, summoning a massive Thornbush, Rooting, interrupting, and pulling down Enemies caught in the centre. The Thornbush Slows Enemies and deals True Damage whenever they move inside it.

abilities.menuDescription:
Damaging Enemy Heroes applies Thorns to the target for 4s. Additional applications refresh the duration. Cannot be applied to Epic Monsters.

Allies deal 5% of their damage as bonus true damage to Enemies afflicted by Thorns.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Damaging Enemy Heroes applies Thorns. Allies damaging afflicted Enemies deal a portion of their damage as bonus True Damage.

perks.description:
Adele triggers Crown of Thorns at 400% effectiveness. 
Royal Flourish has 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 Cooldown and provides 50% Movement Speed, but no longer Mesmerizes.

abilities.simplifiedDescription: Flay your enemies with sharpened claws.

abilities.menuDescription: Akeron deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+65%)(+35%)(+4.5%) physical damage in a cone. Enemies close to Akeron take 1.35x damage. Akeron also heals for 8/12/16/20/24 (+1.75/2.5/3.25/4/4.75%). The heal is reduced to 20% for Non-Heroes, and increased by 200% on kill. If an Enemy Hero is killed, Akeron becomes Awakened. While Akeron is attached to terrain, this ability becomes a roar, affecting the area around him. Awakened: Shred 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Physical Armor and Magical Armor for 5s.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Crush enemies in your gaping maw, damaging them while sustaining yourself.

abilities.menuDescription: Akeron opens his maw and launches the Demon's Eye forward. The Eye moves slowly, firing off 10 (+10%) fireballs around it. Refire the ability to pause the Eye mid-flight. Each fireball deals 18/29/40/51/62 (+14%) magical damage and Slows Enemies by 7%, up to a max of 35%. If an Enemy is within range, the Eye will fire an additional homing fireball at them. Each subsequent hit on the same Target deals 20% less damage, stacking up to a 80% reduction. When Awakened, the number of fireballs is increased by 50%.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Launch the Demon's Eye at foes, revealing them as it spews damaging and slowing flames.

abilities.menuDescription: Akeron fires a web, stopping on the first Target hit and causing various effects depending on the Target's type. Heroes or Units: Damages for 70/95/120/145/170 (+30%) magical damage and Roots for 1s, also creating a web field that Slows Enemies by 35%. World: Lashes to it for up to 5s. While attached to terrain, Akeron can use abilities or leap to the ground, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+50%)(+30%) physical damage, Knocking Up, and Stunning Enemies for 1s. Awakened: Root and Stun Duration increased to 1.25.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Fire a web, rooting and slowing enemies caught in it, or latching yourself to terrain.

abilities.menuDescription: Akeron Slows himself by 35% while Pulling and dealing 15/20/25 (+4%) magical damage to all Enemies in a cone every 0.25s for 3s. If an Enemy Hero collides with Akeron, he bites them, dealing 55/75/95 (+75%)(+40%) physical damage while healing for 2.5/3.5/4.5% Missing Health + 40/50/60% of bite damage dealt. Akeron Executes Enemies bitten under 12% (+3.5%)(+2.5%) of their Max Health. Each time Akeron successfully executes a Hero, he gains 100/125/150 Maximum Health permanently, also healing for 2.5x the bite value.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Open your maw wide, pulling in all enemies in your path to consume those that get too close.

abilities.menuDescription:
Akeron gains up to 100 stacks of Hunger, each granting 0.25% increased healing and lasting 3s and refreshing on application.

Akeron gains Hunger each time he hits an Enemy Unit with a basic attack or ability. He gains additional Hunger when damaged by an Enemy Hero.

When Akeron reaches max stacks he becomes Awakened for 10s granting him 5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8/8.75/9.5/10.25/11/11.75/12.5/13.25/14/14.75/15.5/16.25/17/17.75% (+0.75% per level) Damage Reduction, and granting his basic abilities extra effects.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Gain Hunger through battle and become Awakened to your true demonic power.

perks.description: Akeron becomes camouflaged when attaching to terrain, gaining 1.5% Max Health Regen and generating 8 Hunger per second while he remains there.

perks.description: Akeron can fire an additional web projectile from the wall or ground once, allowing him to leap from surface to surface or to Root from where he hangs.
perks.name: Perk_DemonKing_DeathFromAbove

perks.description: Consume now Pushes instead of Pulls and deals 275% increased tick damage, but can no longer bite.
perks.name: Perk_DemonKing_VortexOfTorment

80 Magical Power: Rally Point's Heal is increased by 50%.

frost-snap.description: Deal 10% extra damage to immobilized targets.
frost-snap.name: Frost Snap

source_alternatives.description: Deal +10% Damage to Immobilized or Slowed Targets.

source_value.description: Deal +10% Damage to Immobilized or Slowed Targets.

frost-snap.status: needs review: patch or supporting sources are unverified

uncertainties.detail: The official 1.14 description names immobilized targets. The Statz catalog also names slowed targets. Whether a slow alone qualifies remains unverified; both sources agree on the 10% bonus against immobilized targets.

harmonic-currents.description: Casting an ability restores missing health and missing mana over 3 seconds: one tick on activation, then one tick each second. The restoration amount remains unverified.
harmonic-currents.name: Harmonic Currents

source_alternatives.description: Casting an Ability restores 2% of your Missing Health and Missing Mana over 3s: one tick on activation, then one tick each second.
Casting an Ability restores 2% of your Missing Health and Missing Mana over 3s.

harmonic-currents.status: needs review: patch or supporting sources are unverified

uncertainties.detail: The 1.16 release notes specify 2.5% of missing health and mana; the Statz catalog specifies 2%. The 1.16.4 notes explicitly change timing, but do not resolve the amount.

mending.description: After taking damage from an enemy hero, restore 3/4/5/6% of missing health at levels 1/6/11/16. The regeneration duration remains unverified.
mending.name: Mending

source_alternatives.description: After taking Hero Damage, restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health over 8s.

source_value.description: After taking Hero Damage, restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health over 8s.

mending.status: needs review: patch or supporting sources are unverified

uncertainties.detail: The 1.14 release notes specify 3 seconds; the Statz catalog specifies 8 seconds. Later published changes update the healing percentages without resolving this duration discrepancy.
